sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे संरब्धे मम पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम्॥ अमृष्यमाणे दुर्धर्षे कथमासीन्मनो हि वः।
en: Dhritarastra said What, (O Sanjaya) became the state of your minds when, filled with rage, the invincible one (i.e. Arjuna) entered into my son's army?

sa: स शब्दः सुमहान् राजन् दिशः सर्वा व्यनादयत्। त्रासयामास तत् सैन्यं युगान्त इव सम्भृतः॥
en: That loud sound, o king, filled all the quarters with its echoes. It frightened the troops as if the end of the Yuga had come.

sa: ततो निवारितः कर्णो धार्तराष्ट्रेण मारिष। कर्णोऽपिनोत्तरं प्राह शल्योऽप्यभिमुखः परान्। ततः प्रहस्य राधेयः पुनर्याहीत्यचोदयत्॥
en: Karna was pacified, Osire and did not speak anything more. Shalya, then advanced against his enemies. Thereupon smilingly Karna once more excited Shalya saying-"go on."

sa: संजय उवाच राधेयः प्रहसन् भरतर्षभ॥ एवमुक्तस्तु अब्रवीच तदा कर्णो गुरुं शारद्वतं कृपम्।
en: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to (by Kripa), Karna the son of Radha then replied smilingly to the preceptor Kripa, the son of Saradvat.

sa: क्षत्रियप्रवरो लोके नित्यं शूराभिसत्कृतः। किं त्वस्य युध्यमानस्य संग्रामे क्षत्रियर्षभः॥ शिरश्छेत्स्यति संक्रुद्धः शत्रुरालक्षितो भुवि।
en: But while struggling in battle, some one foremost among the Kshatriyas, some wellknown person in the world, worked up with anger, will cut-off his head.'

sa: अद्य कर्णं हतं पश्य मच्छरैः शकलीकृतम्। मां रा द्रक्ष्यसि गोविन्द कर्णेन निहतं शरैः॥
en: O Govinda, today either I will slay Karna and hack him to pieces with my weapons or he will see me killed by his arrows.

sa: व ते वीय क चास्त्राणि यत्त्वां निर्जित्य संयुगे। गाण्डीवधन्वा हतवान् प्रेक्षतस्ते जयद्रथम्॥
en: Where was your prowess and where your weapons, when defeating you in battle, the wielder of Gandiva killed Jayadratha in your very presence?

sa: संजय उवाच द्रोणस्य मतमाज्ञाय योद्धुकामस्य तां निशाम्। दुर्योधनो महाराज वश्यान् भ्रातूनुवाच ह॥
en: Sanjaya said Aware of the intentions of Drona as desirous of fighting during that night, Duryodhana, O mighty monarch, addressed his obedient brothers.

sa: यदर्थ धार्तराष्टैण सततं मानितो भवान्॥ तं पार्थ जहि राधेय किं ते हत्वा युधिष्ठिरम्।
en: "O son of Radha, leaving aside Partha, for whom you are always honored by the son of Dhritarashtra, what will you reap by killing Yudhishthira?

sa: उदक्रोशन् सोमकास्तत्र पार्थ पुरःसराश्चर्जुन भिन्धि कर्णम्। छिन्धस्य मूर्धानमलं चिरेण श्रद्धां च राज्याद् धृतराष्ट्रसूनोः॥
en: The Somakas called loudly to Partha, “Go haste and slay Karna and by that put an end to the hope of Dhritarashtra's son for empire."

sa: महादेवं तोषयामास योऽस्त्रैः साक्षात् सुयुद्धेन महानुभावः। लेभे ततः पाशुपतं सुघोरं त्रैलोक्यसंहारकरं महासम्॥
en: High-spirited as he is, after satisfying Mahadeva in battle he received the most terrible weapon Pashuput, powerful enough to annihilate the three worlds.

sa: ब्राह्मणेन तपो नूनं चरितं दुश्चरं महत्। तथा हि युधि संक्रुद्धो दहति क्षत्रियर्षभान्॥
en: They said-Surely this Brahmana has practised mighty ascetic austerities, by virtue of which enraged in battle he is consuming these foremost of Kshatriyas.

sa: आपतत्सु च वेगेन वध्यमाने बलेऽपि च। विगाढायां रजन्यां च राजा दैन्यं परं गतः॥
en: In that dark hour of night they furiously assailed the Pandava troop and began to slaughter them. Seeing all this king Yudhishthira became highly depressed.

sa: संजय उवाच तस्मादेव व्रजाम्याशु यथा मे स गुरुर्गतः। एतावदुक्त्वा शैनेय आचार्य परिवर्जयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, that grandson of Sini, dashed forward avoiding the preceptor; and O king, then addressing his charioteer he said

sa: संजय उवाच तथा ब्रुवन्तं परुषं कर्णो मद्रधिपं तदा। परुषं द्विगुण भूयः प्रोवाचाप्रियदर्शनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said To the king of Madras, who was speaking such harsh words Karna, of unpleasant looks, spoke words again twice as harsh.

sa: कर्णश्च मम पुत्राश्च सर्वे चान्ये च पार्थिवाः। तेन वै दुष्प्रणीतेन गता वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: as Karna and my sons as all the other kings, through his greatly impolitic act, have already gone to the abode of wealth.

sa: एते समाहितास्तात रक्षियन्ति न संशयः। न द्रोणः सह सैन्येन कृतवर्मा च संयुगे॥
en: These warriors all, with great care, will surely exert themselves for protecting me. Neither Drona at the head of his troops, nor Kritavarman.

sa: यस्य यद्धि रणे व्यङ्गं पितृतो मातृतोऽपि वा॥ कर्मतः शीलतो वापि स तच्छ्रावयते युधि।
en: In that battle, his antagonist was made to hear by a hero whatever matter or ridicule he had of his father, mother, conduct of character.

sa: अतश्च प्रहितो युद्धे मया कर्णाय राक्षसः। न ह्यन्यः समरे रात्रौ शक्तः कर्णं प्रबाधितुम्॥
en: For this reason also was the Rakshasa dispatched by me to meet Karna. No one else couid have checked the latter in this nocturnal fight.

sa: श्रान्ता भवन्तो निद्रान्धाः सर्व एव सवाहनाः। तमसा च वृते सैनये रजसा बहुलेन च॥
en: "You all are fatigued and oppressed with drowsiness; and your animals also are so. Both the armes are enveloped with darkness and clouds of dust.

sa: अहं त्वामनुजानामि वीर्येण च बलेन च। जहि कर्ण रणे शूर मातङ्गमिव केसरी॥
en: I am fully aware of your chivalry and strength. Do, O hero, slay that Karna battle even as a lion kills an elephant.

sa: अभीक्ष्णं चोदयन्नश्वान् प्रेक्षते मां मुहुर्मुहुः। न च पश्यामि समरे कर्णं प्रति पलायितुम्॥
en: Repeatedly urging on his horses he is looking at me. I will not be able to tear me away from Karna in battle.

sa: हन्त शल्य विजानीहि हन्त भूयो ब्रवीमे ते। यदप्यन्योऽबवीद् वाक्यं वाहीकानां च कुत्सितम्॥१०
en: You should know this, O Shalya; I will speak to you again these words blaming the Vahikas which another person said to me.

sa: सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन ध्वजं च सतपातयत्। रथं च तिलशो राजन् व्यधमत् तस्य धन्विनः॥
en: (He then), with a broad-headed shaft, O king, struck down the charioteer and the standard and cut-off into minute fragments the car of that bowman.

sa: न चेत् तदभिमन्येत तस्मै दद्यामहं पुनः। शकटं रत्नसम्पूर्ण यो मे ब्रूयाद् धनंजयम्॥
en: I shall further more confer upon him, if he is not satisfied, a cart-load of jewels who will tell me where Dhananjaya is.

sa: यं समासाद्य पुत्रैर्मे कृतं वैरं महारथैः। तं सूततनयं तात कथं भीमो ह्ययोधयत्॥
en: How did Bhima also fight with that son of Suta, O sire, relying on whom my sons provoked hostilities with many mighty carwarriors?

sa: अलं त्रासेन वः शूरा नैष कश्चिन्मयि स्थिते। महमेनं ग्रहीष्यामि जीवग्राहं न संशयः॥
en: O heroes, you need not fear; Abhimanyu is nothing so long as I am here. For certain, I will capture him alive (today).

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तस्य दूतेन दुपदस्य तदा नृप। चोरस्येव गृहीतस्य न प्रावर्तत भारती॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by that messenger, O king, the king Drupada, like a thief caught (red handed), could not utter a word.

sa: शल्य उवाच एवमुक्तः स भगवाञ्छच्या तां पुनरब्रवीत्। विक्रमस्य न कालोऽयं नहुषो बलवत्तरः॥
en: Shalya said The god, being thus spoken to, thus addressed Sachi in reply-'This is not the time for (showing) strength, Nahusha is stronger.

sa: पराशर उवाच कः कस्य चोपकुरुते कश्च कस्मै प्रयच्छति। प्राणी करोत्ययं कर्म सर्वमात्मार्थमात्मना॥
en: Nobody in this world does good to another. Nobody makes gifts to others. All persons are seen to act for their own selves.

sa: शुक्र उवाच यः परेषां नरो नित्यमतिवादांस्तितिक्षते। देवयानि विजानीहि तेन सर्वमिदं जितम्॥ उच्यते॥ यः समुत्पतितं क्रोधं निगृह्णाति हयं यथा। स यन्तेत्युच्यते सद्भिर्न यो रश्मिषु लम्बते॥२१.
en: Shukra said: O Devayani, know that the man who does not regard the evil words of others, conquers every thing. The wise men call him a true charioteer who holds tightly the reins of his horses. He is a true man who subdues his rising anger.

sa: भये महति मग्नांश्च पाति नित्यं जनार्दनः॥ स तं युधिष्ठिरो ज्ञात्वा याथातथ्येन भारत।
en: That Janardana ever saves those who are overwhelmed with great terror. O descendant of the Bharata race, perfectly aware of this fact, Yudhishthira,

sa: श्मश्रु रोम च केशाश्च शिरा स्नायु च चर्म च। इन्द्रियं घ्राणसंज्ञातं नासिकेत्यभिसंज्ञिता॥
en: The nose is known as the organ of smell. The object of that senses, viz., scent, is known as the attribuite of earth.

sa: अब्रवीत प्रहसन् राजन् कुत्सयन्निव पाण्डवम्। कथं नाम कुले जातः क्षत्रधर्मे व्यवस्थितः॥ प्रजह्यात् समरं भीतः प्राणान् रक्षन् महाहवे। न भवान् क्षत्रधर्मेषु कुशलो हीति मे मतिः॥
en: O king, said, smiling and censuring the son of Pandu-"In what family are you born? You are to observe the duties of a Kshatriya. Why do you leave the battle-field in haste, to save your life? Methinks, you do not know the duties of a Kshatriya.

sa: न पापे प्रतिपाप: स्यात् साधुरेव सदा भवेत्। आत्मनैव हतः पापो यः पापं कर्तुमिच्छति॥
en: There should be no wrong over wrong; rather one should deal honestly. The sinful person, who desires to commit a crime, is slain by himself.

sa: असांनिध्याद्धि पार्थानामिदं नः कदनं कृतम्। न चासुरैर्न गन्धर्वैर्न च यक्षैर्न च राक्षसैः॥
en: That son of Kunti who and Janarddana for his protector, is incapable of being defeated even by celestials. Asuras, Gandharvas. Yakshas, and Rakshasas.

sa: मा चैतानप्रियं ब्रूहि मा वै व्रज महारणम्। वक्तव्या मारिषान्से तु न वक्तव्यास्तु मादृशाः॥
en: Do not, O son of Kunti, fight again. Do not approach heroes and use harsh words towards them and do not go to great battles.”

sa: न चास्य तृष्णा विरता पिबमानस्य संकटे॥ अभीप्सति तदा नित्यमतृप्तः स पुनः पुनः।
en: Drinking that honey in such a pitiable condition, his thirst, however, appeased. Unsatiated with repeatedly drinking the same the person desired for more.

sa: माया हि बहवः सन्ति शास्त्रमाश्रित्य चिन्तिताः। तेषां युद्धं तु पापिष्ठं वेदयन्ति पुराविदः॥
en: There are many contrivances mentioned in the scriptures. Of them persons acquainted with the past history have mentioned battle as the most sinful.

sa: दमेन शोभते विप्रः क्षत्रियो विजयेन तु। धनेन वैश्यः शूद्रस्तु नित्यं दाक्ष्येण शोभते॥
en: The Brahmana shines by self-control; the Kshatriya by victory; the Vaishya by riches; while the Shudra always shines in glory through clever serving.

sa: आनृण्यं वा कथं मा गच्छेयुः केन कर्मणा॥ एतदिच्छामहे श्रोतुं परं कौतूहलं हि नः।
en: By doing what acts can men become freed from the debt they owe to their ancestors? We wish to hear this. Great is our curiosity.

sa: स तेषां छिद्रमन्विच्छन् प्रद्रुतो भयपीडितः॥ न च निर्याति वै दूरं न वा तैर्विप्रमोच्यते।
en: Wishing to avoid those terrible creatures, he ran about in fear. He could not go far away from them or free himself from their presence.

sa: इतः कष्टतरं चान्यच्छृणु तद् वै तपोधन॥ मनो मे दीर्यते येन चिन्तयानस्य वै मुहुः।
en: Another event has taken place that is more painful than this, O you having penances for wealth. Repeatedly thinking of it, my heart is breaking.

sa: यथा नारायणो लक्ष्यां जाह्रव्यां च यथोदधिः। यथा रुद्रश्च रुद्राण्यां यता वेद्यां पितामहः॥
en: As Narayana with Lakshmi and as Udadhi (the ocean) with Jahnavi, as Rudra with Rudrani and as the grandsire with the goddess (Sarasvati);

sa: पलायध्वमितः क्षिप्रं मम भ्रातैष वीर्यवान्। आगमिष्यति वो हन्तुं तस्माद् गच्छत मा चिरम्॥
en: "Speedily fly from this place; my powerful brother will (soon) come to kill you. Therefore speed away, do not stay here any longer."

sa: न ध्वजो नार्जुनस्तत्र न रथो न च केशवः। प्रत्यदृश्यत घोरेण शरवर्षेण संवृतः॥
en: Thereupon, neither Arjuna, nor his car, nor Keshava was to be seen on the field, being covered over by that terrible arrowy showers.

sa: लोमश उवाच स तां विसर्जयित्वा तु वसुधां शैलकुण्डलाम्। ततो वराहः संवृत्त एकशृङ्गो महाद्युतिः॥
en: Lomasha said : Having thus sent away the earth adorned with mountains as her ear-rings, he then became a greatly effulgent boar with one tusk.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततो रात्रो व्यतीतायं प्रतिबुद्धोऽस्मि भारत। ततः संचिन्त्य वै स्वप्नमवापं हर्षमुत्तमम्॥
en: Bhishma said When they had passed away, I awoke. O Bharata; I was filled with great joy as I thought of the dream.

sa: पापमाचरतो यत्र कर्मणा व्याहृतेन वा। प्रियस्यापि न मृष्येत स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Not to forgive a person, however dear if he has committe an offence, by act or word, forms the duty of the king.

sa: भक्तं मां भज कल्याणि कमिच्छसि मनस्विनि। तव कल्याणि यत् कार्यं तत् करिष्ये सुमध्यमे॥
en: Accept me devoted to you; O blessed one, what do you wish, O maiden of independent spirit? O blessed one, O you of slender waist.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच नाहमन्नं बुभुक्षे वै पावकं मां निबोधतम्। यदन्नमनुरूपं मे तद् युवां सम्प्रयच्छतम्॥
en: The Brahmana said ; I do not wish to eat ordinary food. Know that I am Agni (fire). Give me that food which suits me.

sa: न ते शोच्या महात्मानः सर्व एव नरर्षभाः। क्षत्रधर्मपराः सन्तस्तथा हि निधनं गताः॥
en: You should not grieve for those foremost of men. They met with death on account of their devotion to the practices of Kshatriyas.

sa: ततोऽन्तरिक्षगो वाचं व्याजहार नलं तदा। हन्तव्योऽस्मि न ते राजन् करिष्यामि तव प्रियम्।२०॥
en: Thereupon that sky-roving one spoke unto Nala. "O king, it behoves you not to kill me. I will render some good to you.

sa: इति मे चिन्तयन्त्या वै हृदि दुःखं प्रवर्तते। पितामहः शान्तनव आचार्यश्च युधां पतिः॥
en: Thinking this, sorrow comes to my heart; this grand father, Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, the preceptor who is the foremost among soldiers,

sa: आहत्य दुन्दुभिं भीमः शङ्ख प्रधमाप्य चासकृत्। विनद्य सिंहनादेन ज्यां विकर्षन् पुनः पुनः॥
en: Caused drums to be struck up. Then he blew his conch with great force and uttering his war-cries, began to twang his bow.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु ये चारपुरुषा मम। ते प्रवृत्तिं प्रयच्छन्ति ममेमां व्युषितां निशाम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said The spies, whom I have in the army of the son of Dhritarashtra, brought me this news when the night has passed away.

sa: यदा तु दिव्यं तद् रूपं ह्रसते वर्धते पुनः। कोऽन्यस्तद्वेदितुं शक्तो योऽपि स्यात् तद्विधोऽपरः॥३४
en: When again His form is sometimes contracted and sometimes expanded, how can any one else save one who is equal to him, perceive his limits?

sa: सुखं निराशः स्वपिति नैराश्यं परमं सुखम्। आशामनाशां कृत्वा हि सुखं स्वपिति पिङ्गला॥
en: One freed from desire and hope sleeps happily. Freedom from hope and desire is happiness. Having renounced desire and hope, Pingala sleeps happily.

sa: नयं मा भगवन् साधो समुद्रमहिषीं प्रियाम्। गङ्गां तत्र निवत्स्यामि यथा वा तात मन्यसे॥
en: "O exalted one, O pious one, O sire, take me to the Ganga, the favourite wife of the Ocean or do what you think proper.

sa: स हि क्रुद्धः समर्थस्त्वां पुत्र पीडयितुं रुषा। रैभ्यश्चापि तपस्वी च कोपनश्च महानृषिः॥
en: O son, this Raibhya is a great Rishi and an ascetic of wrathful temper. If wrathful he can do you harm in anger.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच सा नमस्कृत्य देवेभ्यः प्रहस्य नलमब्रवीत्। प्रणयस्व यथाश्रद्धं राजन् किं करवाणि ते॥
en: Brihadashva said: Saluting the celestials, (Damayanti) smilingly said to Nala, "O king! love me with due respect and say what shall I do for you.

sa: अकस्मादिह यः कश्चिदर्थं प्राप्नोति पूरुषः। तं हठेनेति मन्यन्ते स हि यत्नो न कस्यचित्॥
en: If a person in the world attains, by accident, to an accession of wealth-people consider it derived from chance for none has tried for it.

sa: स निमित्त विनष्टे तु ममार सहसा शिशुः। तं मृतं पुत्रमादाय विललाप ततः पिता।॥
en: When the instrumental cause of his life was destroyed, the child (Medhavi) suddenly died. Thereupon taking up his dead son the father began to lament.

sa: लालप्यमानं तं दृष्ट्वा मुनयः परमार्तवत्। ऊचुर्वेदविदः सर्वे गाथां यां तां निबोध मे॥
en: Now hear from me the verse that was recited by the Rishis learned in the Vedas when they saw the Rishi thus mourning.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् कैलासं पर्वतं ययौ। कृष्णद्वैपायनो व्यासः सह शिष्यैः श्रुतानुगैः॥
en: Having said this, the illustrious Krishna Dvaipayana, Vyasa, accompanied by his disciples, who always followed the dictates of the Vedas, went towards the Kailasa mountain.

sa: मुखस्य वर्णो न विकल्पतेऽस्य चेलुश्च गात्राणि न चापि तस्य। सिंहोन्नतं चाप्यभिगर्जतोऽस्य शुश्राव लोकोऽद्भुतवीर्यमवयम्॥
en: The color of his face did not change and his limbs did not tremble. People only heard his lion-like roars which indicated his wonderful valour.

sa: अब्रुवं मातलिं भीतं पश्य मे भुजयोर्बलम्। अस्त्राणां च प्रभावं वैधनुषो गाण्डिवस्य च॥
en: I spoke to terrified Matali, “behold the prowess of my arms and the power of my weapons and that of my bow Gandiva.

sa: पापीयांस इमे भूत्वा संतीर्णाः पतयो मम। वेत्स्यन्ति चैव भद्राणि राजन् पुण्येन कर्मणा॥
en: O king, these my husbands, freed from the wretched state of slavery, will be able to achieve prosperity by their own virtuous acts.

sa: नैतद् वेद महेन्द्रोऽपि न यमो न च यक्षराट्। वरुणोऽप्यथवा वायुः कुतो वेत्स्यन्ति मानवाः॥
en: Neither Indra, nor Yama, nor the king of the Yakshas, nor Varuna, nor Vayu knows it, how could it (then) be known to human beings?

sa: भूतेष्वभावं संचिन्त्य ये तु बुद्धेः परं गताः। न शोचन्ति कृतप्रज्ञाः पश्यन्तः परमां गतिम्॥
en: He who has attained the highest state, being conscious of the great deficiency of all matter and seeing before him the final doom, never grieves.

sa: बाहू महान्तौ कृत्वा तु तथाऽऽस्यं च भयानकम् स्थितमावृत्य पन्थानं येन यान्ति कुरूद्वहाः॥
en: With out-stretched arms and terrible face he stood obstructing the way on which those perpetuators of the Kuru race (the Pandavas) were proceeding.

sa: आकारं रक्षमाणस्तु न स तान् समुदैक्षत। पुनर्वसनमुत्क्षिप्य प्रतरिष्यन्निव स्थलम्॥ आरुरोह ततः सर्वे जहसुश्च पुनर्जनाः। द्वारं तु पिहिताकारं स्फाटिकं प्रेक्ष्य भूमिपः। प्रविशन्नाहतो मूनि व्याघूर्णित इव स्थितः॥
en: Concealing his emotions, he even did not cast his eyes on them. Seeing him again draw up his clothes to cross a piece of land (made of crystal), mistaking it for water, all men laughed aloud. Then king (Duryodhana) mistook a closed door made of crystal as open.

sa: क्व सा पुण्यजला रम्या नदी द्विजनिषेविता। क्व नु ते ह नगा हृद्याः फलपुष्पोपशोभिताः॥
en: Where is that enchanting rivulet of holy waters, inhabited by water-fowls of various species? Where again are those delightful trees adorned with flowers and fruits?

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच एवमेतानि पुरुषा दुःखानि च सुखानि च। आप्नुवन्ति महाबुद्धे नोत्कण्ठां कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: The Brahmana said: O greatly intelligent one, all men are thus subject to happiness or misery. You should not therefore grieve for it.

sa: तस्मात् सत्यं ब्रुवन् साक्षी धर्मार्थाभ्यां न हीयते। कश्यपस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रह्लादः पुत्रमब्रवीत्॥
en: Therefore a witness should always tell the truth. A witness should always tell the truth never loses his religious merits and earthly possessions.

sa: एतद् राजन् मम धनं प्रतिपाणोऽस्ति कस्तव। येन मां त्वं महाराज धनेन प्रतिदीव्यसे॥
en: O king, is my stake. O great king, what is your counter stake, the wealth with which you wish to play with me?

sa: हंसानां वचनं यत् तु तन्मां दहति पार्थिव। त्वत्कृते हि मया वीर राजानः संनिपातिता:॥
en: O prince, the speeches of the swans are burning me out. It is for you indeed, O lord I have caused the kings assemble here.

sa: मा राजन् कश्मलं घोरं प्रविशो बुद्धिनाशनम्। सम्प्रधार्य महाराज यत् क्षेमं तत् समाचर॥
en: "O king, do not yield yourself to the great depression which destroys one's reason. O great king, mustering fortitude, do what is beneficial".

sa: अथ कालेन महता स मत्स्यः सुमहानभूत्। अलिञ्जरे यथा चैव नासौ समभवत् किल॥
en: After a long period of time that fish grew to be so large that there was no room for it in that vessel.

sa: भव उवाच ददामि तेऽस्त्रं दयितमहं पाशुपतं विभो। समर्थोधारणे मोक्षे संहारे चासि पाण्डव॥
en: Shiva said: O exalted Pandava, I shall give you my favourite weapon called Pashupata. You are capable of holding, hurling and withdrawing it.

sa: ते च त्रयोदशं वर्षं पारयिष्यन्ति चेद् व्रतम्। जेष्यामस्तान् वयं राजन् रोचतां ते परंतप॥
en: O king, O chastiser of foes, we shall then be able to defeat the Pandavas if they reappear. Let this plan recommend itself to you.

sa: लेभे कामाशुभान् राजन् कर्मणा निर्जितान् स्वयम्। सह तेनैव विप्रेण गुरुणा स गुरुप्रियः॥
en: O king, that lover of his preceptor secured for his preceptor by his meritorious acts all those blessings of which he was entitled.

sa: विनता चाब्रवीत् स्कन्दं मम त्वं पिण्डदः सुतः। इच्छामि नित्यमेवाहं त्वया पुत्र सहासितुम्॥
en: Vinata also said to Skanda, “You are my son entitled to offer me oblations. O son, I desire to live with you always."

sa: सा वै प्रसादयामास तं गुरुं पुत्रकारणात्। आत्मनश्चैव मातुश्च प्रसादं च चकार सः॥
en: She gratified the preceptor (Bhrigu) in order to obtain a son for herself and for her mother; and he too granted her desire.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच जनप्रवादान् सुबहूण्वन्नपि नराधिपः। हिया च धर्म संयोगात् पार्थो द्यूतमियात् पुनः॥
en: The king, the son of Pritha (Yudhisthira) even hearing these various remarks again sat at dice from shame and sense of (Kshatriyas) duty.

sa: कथं वासो विकर्तेयं न च बुध्येत मे प्रिया। विचिन्त्यैवं नलो राजा सभां पर्यचरत्तदा॥
en: 'How shall I cut off her cloth, so that my beloved may not awake.' Thus thinking, king Nala then began to wander about that inn.

sa: ज्ञात्वा प्रथमजं तं तु वढेराङ्गिरसं सुतम्। उपेत्य देवाः पप्रच्छुः कारणं तत्र भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, knowing him to be the first son of Angiras by Agni, the celestials came and enquired about the mystery.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तावब्रवीद् देवः स्वागतं वां महाबलौ। ददामि वां वरं श्रेष्ठं प्रीतिमर्हि मम जायते॥
en: Seeing them the deity said to them, "O mighty heroes, be welcome. I am gratified with you. I shall therefore give you some excellent boons."

sa: मुहूर्तं शरवर्षं तत् प्रतिगृह्य पिनाकधृक्। अक्षतेन शरीरेण तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥ स दृष्ट्वा बाणवर्ष
en: Having born that shower of arrows for a moment, the wiclder of Pinaka, (Shiva) stood there in unwounded body like an immovable mountain.

sa: पितुः पितामहा ये च तथैव प्रपितामहाः। प्रीतास्ते सततं पुत्र दमेनावां च पूजया॥
en: Your father, grand-father and great grandfathers are, O son, always pleased with you, for your (great) self-control and for your reverence for us.

sa: गतिमिष्टां तपो ज्ञानं मेधां च परमां गतः। सत्पुत्रेण त्वया पुत्र नित्यं काले सुपूजितौ॥
en: And with knowledge, high intelligence and fulfillment of your desires. O son, you are good and dutiful son, we are always taken care by you.

sa: अब्रवीच्चैव मां बाला आयान्तु सहिताः सुराः। त्वया सह नरव्याघ्र मम यत्र स्वयंवरः॥
en: The Maiden said: O the foremost of men, I wish the assembled celestials would come with you where my Svayamvara will take place.

sa: वयं तु तमृते वीरं वनेऽस्मिन् द्विपदां वर। अवधानं न गच्छामः काम्यके सह कृष्णया।॥
en: In the absence of that hero, that foremost of men, we shall never have peace of mind with Krishna (Draupadi) in this forest of Kamyaka.

sa: ततो रत्नान्युपादाय पुरी माहिष्मती ययौ। तत्र नीलेन राज्ञा स चक्रे युद्धं नरर्षभः॥
en: Thereupon, having received wealth that best of men, (Sahadeva), marched towards the city of Mahishmati. He fought there a battle with king Nila.

sa: यस्य दोषैः प्रकुपितं चित्तं मुह्यति देहिनः। उन्माद्यति स तु क्षिप्रं साधनं तस्य शास्त्रतः॥
en: The illness of the man who goes mad, his mind being demoralised with vices, must be cured according to the methods prescribed in the Shastras.

sa: अग्निरुवाच नष्टकीर्तिरहं लोके भवान् जातो हुताशनः। भवन्तमेव ज्ञास्यन्ति पावकं न तु मां जनाः॥
en: Agni said : My reputation has been destroyed in this world, you have become the fire, people will know you as Agni and not me.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच एवं स पुरुषव्याघ्र शाल्वराजो महारिपुः। युध्यमानो मया संख्ये वियदभ्यगमत् पुनः॥
en: Krishna said: O best of men, the great enemy, the king Shalva, thus encountered by me in battle, again rose in the sky.

sa: इति गीताः काश्यपेन गाथा नित्यं क्षमावताम्। श्रुत्वा गाथाः क्षमायास्त्वं तुष्य द्रौपदि मा क्रुधः।४५॥
en: These verses were always chanted by Kashyapa in honor of the forgiving; hearing these verses of forgiveness, be pleased and be not angry, O Draupadi.

sa: न त्वमस्मिन् वने घोरे बिभेषि कनकप्रभा किमर्थं च त्वया विद्वो वराहो मत्परिग्रहः॥
en: O golden-splendoured one, are you not afraid of this fearful forest? Why have you pierced the boar that was first aimed by me.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच अहं दुर्योधनं हन्ता कर्णं हन्ता धनंजयः। शकुनि चाक्षकितवं सहदेवो हनिष्यति॥
en: Bhima said I shall be the slayer of Duryodhana, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) will be the slayer of Karna. Sahadeva will kill the gambler Shakuni.

sa: अक्षयूते नलं जेता भवान् हि सहितो मया। निषधान् प्रतिपद्यस्व जित्वा राज्यं नलं नृपम्॥
en: With my help you shall conquer Nala at a game of dice; and vanquishing king Nala and wining his kingdom, do you govern the Nishadhas?"

sa: गृहे वसन्तं गोमायुं त्वं वै मोहान्न बुध्यसे। दुर्योधनस्य रूपेण शृणु काव्यां गिरं मम॥
en: A jackal is in your house in the form of Duryodhana. You do not know this out of folly. Listen to what Kavya (Shukra) said.

sa: गच्छ संजय जानीहि भ्रातरं विदुरं मम। यदि जीवति रोषेण मया पापेन निथुतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said : O Sanjaya, go and ascertain whether my brother, Vidura, expelled by my wretched self through anger, still lives or not.

sa: सा ग्रस्यमाना ग्राहेण शोकेन च परिप्लुता। नात्मानं शोचति तथा यथा शोचति नैषधम्॥
en: Being devoured by the monster and swelling with sorrow, she grieved not so much for herself, as for the king of the Nishadhas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो न ममृषे चैद्यस्तद् भीष्मवचनं तदा। उवाच चैनं संक्रुद्धः पुनर्भीष्ममथोत्तरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard these words of Bhishma, the Chedi king could not brook them. He thus replied to Bhishma in great wrath.

sa: ईप्सितो ह्येष वै कामो वरं चैनं प्रयच्छ मे। त्वत्तोऽद्य भगवन्नस्त्रं कृत्स्नमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: “O exalted one, this is the object of my wishes; grant me this boon, (namely) I desire to learn from you all weapons."

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आमन्त्रयामि भरतांस्तथा वृद्धं पितामहम्। राजानं सोमदत्तं च महाराजं च बाह्निकम्॥
en: Yudhisthira said I bid farewell to all the descendants of Bharata, to my old grandsire (Bhisma) to king Somadatta, the great king Valhika.

sa: दृष्ट्वैव तामृष्यशृङ्गः प्रहृष्टः सम्भ्रान्तरूपोऽभ्यपतत् तदानीम्। प्रोवाच चैनां भवतः श्रमाय गच्छाव यावन्न पिता ममैति॥
en: As soon as Rishyashringa saw her, he became exceedingly glad and rushing towards her said “Let us go to your hermitage before my father returns.”

sa: दृष्ट्वा च मम तत् सर्वं ज्वररूपमिवाभवत्। गृहीत्वा तत् तु गच्छन्ति समुद्रौ पूर्वदक्षिणौ॥ तथैव पश्चिमं यान्ति गृहीत्वा भरतर्षभ। उत्तरं तु न गच्छन्ति विना तात पतत्रिणः॥
en: Seeing all this, I felt myself as if attacked with fever. O best of men, O sire, they (jars) were taken to the eastern and the southern seas. They were also taken to the western sea. But none can go to the northern sea except birds.

sa: नास्ति वै जातितः शत्रुः पुरुषस्य विशाम्पते। येन साधारणी वृत्तिः स शत्रुर्नेतरो जनः॥
en: O king, none can by nature by any person's foe. He, and none else, is one's enemy who has common pursuits with another.

sa: अपां ह्रदं च पुण्याख्यं भृगुतुङ्गं च पर्वतम्। उष्णीगङ्गे च कौन्तेय सामात्यः समुपस्पृश॥
en: O son of Kunti, touch with your ministers this lake, called Punya and this Bhrigutunga (mountain) and also these two rivers called Tashniganga.

sa: तत्र तौ समनुज्ञातौ पित्रा कौन्तेय जग्मतुः। आश्रमे त्वभवद् रैभ्यो भार्या चैव परावसोः॥
en: O son of Kunti, thercupon those two, taking the permission of their father, went away. Raivya remained in the hermitage with Paravasu's wife.

sa: स तु भाराभिभूतात्मा न तथा शीघ्रगोऽभवत्। अथाब्रवीद् द्रौपदी च नकुलं च युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Being thus oppressed with the weight, he (the Rakshasa) could not go fast as before. Then Yudhishthira thus spoke to Draupadi and Nakula.

sa: तं पादपैः पुष्पधरैरुपेतं नगोत्तमं प्राप्य महारथानाम्। मनःप्रसादः परमो बभूव यथा दिवं प्राप्य मरुद्गणानाम्॥
en: Getting to that excellent mountain, adorned with blossoming trees, those mighty carwarriors were supremely glad at heart as the Maruts on reaching the heavenly regions.

sa: अनसूयुः कृतज्ञश्च कल्याणानि च सेवते। सुखानि धर्ममर्थं च स्वर्गं च लभते नरः॥
en: Whoever with a heart full of gratitude and free from malice try to do what is good, obtain wealth, virtue, happiness and heaven.

sa: कृष्ण उवाच शुश्रूषवः पाण्डवास्ते ब्राह्मणाश्च समागताः। द्रौपदी सत्यभामा च तथाहं परमं वचः॥
en: Krishna said : The Pandavas, the assembled Brahmanas, Draupadi, Satyablama as well as myself are all desirous of hearing your most excellent words.

sa: विदुर उवाच वस्त्रेण संवृत्य मुखं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। बाहू विशालौ सम्पश्यन् भीमो गच्छति पाण्डवः॥
en: Vidura said The son of Kunti (has gone away), covering his face with cloth, the Pandava Bhima has proceeded along looking at his mighty arms.

sa: सुवाससो हि ते भार्या वल्कलाजिनसंवृताम्। पश्यन्तु दुःखितां कृष्णां सा च निर्विद्यतां पुनः॥
en: Let your wife clad in costly robes look at the afflicted Krishna (Draupadi) now in barks and skins and thus increase her misery.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच सर्वं विकारं दृष्ट्वा तु पुण्यश्लोकस्यधीमतः। आगत्य केशिनी सर्वं दमयन्त्यै न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Brihadashva said: Having learnt all about the mental agony of that righteous and wise one, Keshini came back and spoke everything to Damayanti.

sa: ततः प्रभृति ये केचिदज्ञानात् तां पुरी नृपाः। जिगीषन्ति बलाद् राजंस्ते दह्यन्ते स्म वह्निना॥
en: O king, from that day he, who out of ignorance of this, desires to subjugate the city of the king (Nila), is consumed by fire.

sa: वैदर्भी तु तथायुक्तां युवतीं प्रेक्ष्य वै पिता। मनसा चिन्तयामास कस्मै दद्यामिमां सुताम्॥
en: Seeing her attain to puberty, her father, the king of Vidharbha thought in his mind, "To whom shall I give my this daughter?”

sa: पिप्लुं दृष्ट्वा सुनन्दा च राजमाता च भारत। रुदत्यौ तां परिष्वज्य मुहूर्तमिव तस्थतुः॥
en: O Bharata! seeing that mark, Sunanda as well as the mother of the king, wept; and, embracing her, stood there for some time.

sa: ये च वेदविदो विप्रा ये चाध्यात्मविदो जनाः। ते वदन्ति महात्मानं कृष्णंधर्म सनातनम्॥
en: The Brahmanas, learned in the Vedas and persons verscd in the philosophy of the soul say that the illustrious Krishna is eternal virtue.

sa: उपायोऽयं मया दृष्टो निरपायो नरेश्वर। येन दोषो न भविता तव राजन् कथंचन॥
en: "O the most supreme among men, I find out this sinless way, following which no sin, whatever, O king, will hang upon you.

sa: ततः समभवद् रक्षो घोराक्षं भीमदर्शनम्। अब्रूतां तौ तदा रैभ्यं किं कार्यं करवावहै॥
en: Thereupon rose out of it a fearful Rakshasha of fearful eyes. Those two then spoke thus to Raivya, “What are we to do?"

sa: जात्या प्रधानं पुरुषं कुर्वाणं कर्म धिक्कृतम्। कर्म तद् दूषयत्येनं तस्मात् कर्म न शोभनम्॥
en: If, however, a person of superior birth perpetrates censurable deeds, such acts pollute him. Hence, of the two, viz., acts and birth, acts pollute man.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच परमं गृह्यतां तस्य फलं यज्जपितं मया। अर्धं त्वमविचारेण फलं तस्य ह्यवाप्नुहि॥
en: The Brahmana said Take the greatest fruit of the recitations I have practised. Indeed, take half, without any hesitation the entire fruits of that recitation.

sa: कालः सम्पद्यते तत्र कालस्तत्र न वै प्रभुः। स कालस्य प्रभू राजन् स्वर्गस्यापि तथेश्वरः॥
en: Time makes it appearance there for usc. Time is not the ruler there. That supreme region is the ruler of Time as also of Heaven.

sa: ब्रह्म चैव परं सृष्टं ये न जानन्ति तेऽद्विजाः। तेषां बहुविधास्त्वन्यास्तत्र तत्र हि जातयः॥
en: They amongst them are not Brahmanas who cannot understand that every created thing is Supreme Brahma. These, falling away, became members of various (inferior) castes.

sa: बुद्धिसंजननो धर्म आचारश्च सतां सदा। ज्ञेयो भवति कौरव्य सदा तद् विद्धि मे वचः॥
en: Duty must originate from the understanding and the practices of the good should always be determined, O son of Kuru. Obey these words of mine.

sa: इममन्यं च ते कामं ददानि मनसेप्सितम्। न त्वां दोषेण यास्यन्ति व्याधिसम्पीडिताः प्रजाः॥
en: I grant you this other wish that is in your heart! Living creatures shall be possessed by disease, and shall not censure you.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवं विलपतस्तस्य श्रुत्वा तु करुणं वचः। गृहीता शकुनिभेन कपोती वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these piteous cries of the pigeon on the tree, the she-pigeon caught by the fowler began to say aside thus.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यदिदं कर्म लोकेऽस्मिन् शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम्। पुरुषं योजयत्येव फलयोगेन भारता॥१
en: Yudhisthira said In this world, O Bharata, good and bad acts attach themselves to man for the purpose of producing fruits for enjoyment or endurance.

sa: शब्दः श्रोत्रं तथा स्वानि त्रयमाकाशयोनिजम्। वायोः स्पर्शस्तथा चेष्टा त्वक् चैव त्रितयं स्मृतम्॥
en: Sound, the organ of hearing, and all holes,-these three, originate from Space Touch, action, and skin are the three-fold attributes of the Wind.

sa: यूयं हि भाविता यज्ञैः सर्वयज्ञेषु मानवैः॥ मां ततो भावयिष्यध्वमेषा वो भावना मम।
en: Strengthened by the sacrifices that will be celebrated by men, ye will strengthen me. These are the thoughts that I cherish for you

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि इतिहासं पुरातनम्। वसिष्ठस्य च संवादं करालजनकस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said I shall, regarding it, relate to you the old discourse that took place between Vashishtha and king Karala of Janaka's race.

sa: विनिष्कान्तं तु तं तु तं दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा। भवो रोषसमाविष्टः शूलोद्यतकरः स्थितः॥
en: Seeing him come out of his stomach and shining bringhtly with energy, Bhava filled with anger, stood with lance uplifted in his hand.

sa: या देवतासु वृत्तिस्ते सास्तु विप्रेषु नित्यदा। क्रुद्धैर्हि विप्रैः कर्माणि कृतानि बहुधा नृप॥
en: You should always treat the Brahmanas like the gods. The Brahmanas, if enraged, can inflict pains in a variety of ways, O King.

sa: अनुसृत्य तु यत्नात् स तथा वै ब्रह्महत्यया॥ तदा गृहीतः कौरव्य निस्तेजाः समपद्यत।
en: But the sin of Brahmanicide followed him closely. Indeed, O son of Kuru, seized by her, Indra became shorn of all his energies.

sa: येनोपायेन शक्येत संनियन्तुं चलं मनः। तं च युक्तो निषेवेत न चैव विचलेत् ततः॥
en: One should with devotion pursue those mcans by which he may control the restive mind. One should never suffer himself to fall away from it.

sa: इहागम्य हि मां राजन् जाप्यं फलमयाचथाः। तन्मे निसृष्टं गृह्णीष्व भव सत्ये स्थिरोऽपि च॥
en: Coming here, O king, you begged of me the fruits of my recitations. Therefore, take what I have given away, if, indeed, you are truthful.

sa: यदि सा रक्तनेत्रान्ता चित्राङ्गी मधुरस्वरा। अद्य नायाति मे कान्ता न कार्यं जीवितेन मे॥
en: If that dear wife of mine, having red eyes, variegated plumes, and sweet voice, does not return to-day, my life itself will have no value.

sa: धृतिर्नाम सुखे दुःखे यथा नाप्नोति विक्रियाम्। तां भजेत सदा प्राज्ञो य इच्छेद् भूतिमात्मनः॥
en: That virtue by which remains unchanged in weal and woe is called fortitude. That wise man who seeks his own well-being always practises this virtue.

sa: यथैषा नानृता वाणी मयाऽद्य समुदीरिता। तेन सत्येन मां देवाः पालयन्तु दहन्तु वा॥
en: This truth I have spoken today, and let the gods bless me for it or destroy me if I have spoken an untruth.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततो जाजलिना तेन समाहूताः पतत्रिणः। वाचमुच्चारयन्ति स्म धर्मस्य वचनात् किल॥
en: Bhishma continued-Then those birds, summoned by Jajali, answered according to the dictates of that religion which preaches abstention from injury to any creature.

sa: सा ते न व्यथते बुद्धिरचला तत्त्वदर्शिनी॥ अहमासं पुरा चेति मनसापि न बुद्ध्यते।
en: Your understanding, firm and endued with true vision, is unmoved. You do not, even in your mind realise what you were sometime before.

sa: कथं चोत्पादितः खड्गः कस्मै चाय केन च। पूर्वाचार्यं च खड्गस्य प्रब्रूहि प्रपितामह॥
en: How was the sword first created and why? Who also was the first teacher in that weapon? Tell me all this, O grandfather.

sa: दूरतो मे निवेशश्च अस्माद् देशादिति प्रभो॥ कृतबुद्धिर्द्धमे तस्मिन् वस्तुं तां रजनी ततः।
en: My house is at a great distance from where I am!-He then thought of passing the night under the shade of that tree.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि पृच्छतो भरतर्षभ। उग्रसेनस्य संवादं नारदे केशवस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said About it I shall recite to you the words that Keshava, asked by Ugrasena, said to him on a former occasion.

sa: पुनश्च परिपप्रच्छ भीष्मं धर्मभृतां वरम्। तपः प्रति स चोवाच तस्मै सर्वं कुरूद्वह॥
en: Again the king asked that foremost of virtuous men. That perpetuator of Kuru's race once more began to discourse cheerfully on the subject.

sa: विद्वान् सर्वेषु भूतेषु आत्मना सोपमो भवेत्। कृतकृत्यो विशुद्धात्मा सर्वं त्यजति चैव ह॥
en: The man of knowledge always considers other creatures like unto himself. Having purified his soul and gained success, he casts off everything here.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तस्मै दत्त्वा स सत्कारं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। शालपुष्मयीं दिव्यां बृसीं वै समकल्पयत्।॥
en: Bhishma said Having offered him hospitality according to the scriptural rites, the crane made an excellent bed of the Shala flowers that lay all around.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मग्नस्य व्यसने कृच्छ्रे किं श्रेयः पुरुषस्य हि। बन्धुनाशे महीपाल राज्यनाशेऽथवा पुनः॥
en: Yudhisthira said What, indeed, is good for a man who is sunk in dire distress, consequent on the loss of friends or kingdom, O king.

sa: भीष्म उवाच कणानां भक्षणे युक्तः पिण्याकस्य च भारत। स्नेहानां वर्जने युक्तो योगी बलमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Engaged, O Bharata, in subsisting upon broken grains of rice and sodden cakes of sesame, and abstaining from oil and butter, the Yogin gains Yoga-power.

sa: यदा न कुरुते भावं सर्वभूतेषु पापकम्। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा॥
en: When one one abstains from injuring all creatures in thought, words, and acts, then he is said to acquire the dignity of Brahma.

sa: अपश्यतां प्रियान् पुत्रांस्तेषां शोको न तिष्ठति। न च पुष्णन्ति संवृद्धास्ते मातापितरौ क्वचित्॥
en: Growing up, their children never maintain them in age. Still do they not feel pained when they do not see their title ones?

sa: दाहयेद् यां महीं कृत्स्नां शोषयेद् वा महोदधिम्। संहरेद् वा जगत् कृत्स्नं विसृष्टं शूलपाणिना।।२६६।
en: Hurled by the illustrious god, that weapon can rive the entire Earth or dry up the waters of the occan or annihilate the entire universe.

sa: अनाथां प्रमदां बालां वृद्धां भीता तपस्विनीम्। वञ्चन्ति नरा ये च ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who lead astray and cheat helpless women, or girls or aged dames, or such women as have been frightened, have to sink in hell.

sa: ततः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा देवर्षि नारदं ततः। निवेदयामास च तं स्वं योगं परमर्षये।॥
en: He then went round the celestial Rishi Naradas, and informed him of the fact of his having begun to practise the highest Yoga.

sa: लीलयाल्पं यथा गात्रात् प्रमृज्यात् तु रजः पुमान्। बहुयत्नेन च महत् पापनिर्हरणं तथा॥
en: Sin is renounced like the fifth on one's body,-a little with a little exertion, and a great quantity when the exertion is greater.

sa: उत्पाद्य पुत्रान् मुनयो नृपते यत्र तत्र ह। स्वेनैव तपसा तेषामृषित्वं विदधुः पुनः॥
en: Great Rishi, O monarch, by begetting children in indiscriminate wombs, gave them the dignity of Rishis by means of their power of asceticism.

sa: आरणेयो विशुद्धात्मा नभसीव दिवाकरः। अथ व्यास: परिक्षिप्तं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्॥ ददृशे सुतमायान्तं दिवाकरसमप्रभम्।
en: Seated in his asylum, Vyasa saw his son approach like a burning fire of scattered flames, or resembling the Sun himself in effulgence.

sa: न देवैरननुज्ञातः कश्चिद् भवति धार्मिकः। एष शक्तोऽसि तपसा दातुं राज्यं धनानि च॥
en: No man can become virtuous unless allowed by the gods. You have become competent to give away kingdoms and riches through your penances!

sa: युगे युगे तु कृष्णेन तोषितो वै महेश्वरः। भक्त्या परमया चैव प्रीतश्चैव महात्मनः॥
en: In every new cycle has Krishna pleased Mahadeva. In every cycle has Mahadeva been pleased with the great devotion of the great Krishna.

sa: प्रसार्य च यथाङ्गानि कूर्मः संहरते पुनः। तद्वद् भूतानि भूतात्मा सृष्टानि हरते पुनः॥
en: As the tortoise extends its limbs and withdraws them again, so the Supreme Soul creates all objects and again withdraws them into Himself.

sa: विमुच्य हृदयग्रन्थिं चक्रमन्ति यथासुखम्। न येषां बान्धवाः सन्ति ये चान्येषां न बान्धवाः॥
en: Loosening all the knots of their hearts, they pass on very happily. They have no friends nor are they the friends of others.

sa: इयं सा परमा शान्तिरियं सा निर्वृति: परा। यं प्राप्य कृतकृत्याः स्म इत्यमन्यन्त योगिनः॥
en: You are the highest Tranquility. You are the highest stoppage of Existence, By attaining to you, Yogins think that they have acquired the highest success.

sa: स गत्वा तप आतिष्ठत् पार्वे तस्योत्तरे गिरेः। हिमवत्प्रभवे शृङ्गे सह देव्या महेश्वरः॥
en: And having repaired to the north side of that mountain, Mahesvara along with the goddess became engaged in austerities on the peak Himavatprabhava.

sa: धनुर्विस्फारमाणस्य यस्य शब्देन लक्ष्मण। सशैला कम्पिता भूमिः सहायैः किं नु तस्य वै॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, what is the use of help to him the sounds of whose stretching bow made the Earth tremble with her mountains?

sa: वज्रसारमयं नूनं हृदयं मे न संशयः। अपश्यन्त्या न तं यद् वै फलतीदं सहस्रधा॥
en: Surely my heart, without doubt, is made of the essence of the thunderbolt, since not beholding him, it is not cracked in a thousand fragments.

sa: नहि प्रेषयिता तात स्वामी प्रेष्यः कथंचन। भवताऽयं जनः सर्वः प्रेष्यः प्लवगसत्तम ॥
en: My child, ore master must on no account be commanded by his servants. foremost of monkeys, all these should be commanded your you.

sa: तथा मया विधातव्यं विश्रमेत यथा कपिः। शेषं च मयि विश्रान्तः सुखी सोऽतितरिष्यति॥
en: It become me to do that by which the monkey may take rest in me and, relieved, may happily traverse the remaining way.

sa: स गत्वा लक्ष्मणः श्रीमान् नदी गोदावरी तदा। स्नात्वा पद्मानि चादाय सफलः पुनरागतः॥
en: And then going to the river Godāvarī, the lovely Lakşmana, performing his bath, and securing lotuses and fruits, came back (to the asylum).

sa: यत्र गच्छत्युपादातुं मूलानि च फलानि च। न विना याति तं खङ्ग न्यासरक्षणतत्परः॥
en: And intent upon preserving his trust, he goes nowhere for procuring fruits and roots without that sword deposited with him as a trust.

sa: नहि मे जीवितं स्थाने हृदयं वावतिष्ठते। क्रोशन: परमार्तस्य श्रुतः शब्दो मया भृशम्॥
en: He is crying aloud in pitiable accents; hearing them my life and soul are incapable of remaining any longer in their proper places.

sa: तौ च याचस्व भर्तारं भरतस्याभिषेचनम्। प्रव्राजनं च रामस्य वर्षाणि च चतुर्दश ॥
en: And ask your husband for these two boons, the installation of Bharata, and the exile of Rāma into the woods for fourteen years.

sa: नहि मेऽविदितं किंचिद् वनेऽस्मिंश्चरतः सदा। चतुरङ्ग ह्यपि बलं प्रसहेम वयं युधि ॥
en: To me always ranging in this forest, nothing whatever is unknown. I can even cope in battle with an army of fourfold forces.

sa: या श्रीः शौर्यं च रामस्य या च कल्याणसत्त्वता। निवृत्तारण्यवासः स्वं क्षिप्रं राज्यमवाप्स्यति॥
en: Considering Rāma's grace, heroism and auspiciousness, (there cannot be any doubt that) returning from the forest, he will speedily regain his own kingdom.

sa: प्रीतोऽस्मि ते महत् कर्म त्वया कृतमिदं प्रभो। प्रदेयो यन्निमित्तं ते परिष्वङ्गो मया कृतः॥
en: Pleased am I with you. You have done a great deed, my brother; for which I have granted you my embrace by way of reward.

sa: संगृहीतमनुष्यश्च सुहृद्भिः साकमात्मवान् । प्राप्तकालं नु मन्येऽहं राजानं वीतसाध्वसा ॥ रामाभिषेकसंकल्पानिगृह्य विनिवर्तय।
en: Now is the time, I apprehend. Renouncing fear, do you forcibly make the monarch remove from his mind his intention of installing Rāma.

sa: तत उत्थाय ते सर्वे स्पृष्ट्वा नद्याः शिवं जलम्। पन्थानमृषिभिर्जुष्टं चित्रकूटस्य तं ययुः॥
en: Then they all arising touched the sacred waters of the river, and began to proceed on the way to Citrakuța inhabited by ascetics.

sa: नहि जातु दुराधर्षों काकुत्स्थौ तव रावण। धर्षणं चाश्रमस्यास्य क्षमिष्येते तु राघवौ ॥
en: O Rāvana, it is beyond your power to defeat the Kakutsthas. They shall not forgive you for this your encroachment upon their asylum.

sa: अञ्जलिं कुर्मि कैकेयि पादौ चापि स्पृशामि ते। शरणं भव रामस्य माधर्मो मामिह स्पृशेत्॥
en: O Kaikeyi, I clasp my palms, I fall at your feet, do you be the protector of Rāma, so that sin may not taint me.

sa: ते तु तस्मिन् महावृक्षे उषित्वा रजनी शुभाम्। विमलेऽभ्युदिते सूर्ये तस्माद् देशात् प्रतस्थिरे॥
en: Having passed the auspicious night underneath that might tree, they, when the sun had risen in unclouded splendour, went away from that place.

sa: अयं हि कृपया राम मां त्रातुमिह संगतः। शेते विनिहतो भूमौ ममाभाग्याद् विहंगमः॥
en: O Rāma, this bird, who, moved by kindness, had come to rescue me, owing to my (ill) luck, lies slain on the ground.

sa: यां विना नोत्सहे वीर मुहूर्तमपि जीवितुम्। क्व सा प्राणसहाया मे सीता सुरसुतोपमा॥
en: Without whom, O hero, I cannot live for a moment-where is that life's help of me Sītā resembling the daughter of a celestial?

sa: ततोऽब्रवीद् दाशरथिः सुमन्त्रं स्पृशन् करेणोत्तमदक्षिणेन। सुमन्त्र शीघ्रं पुनरेव याहि राज्ञः सकाशे भव चाप्रमत्तः॥
en: Thereupon Dasaratha's touching Sumantra by his goodly right hand, said, “O Sumantra, do you again repair to the monarch, but let your senses be unclouded.”

sa: कच्चिद् बलस्य भक्तं च वेतनं च यथोचितम्। सम्प्राप्तकालं दातव्यं ददासि न विलम्बसे॥
en: And do you at the proper time grant your soldiers what you should, provision and pay; and do not delay in doing this?

sa: सा तस्य धर्मार्थसमाधियुक्तं निशम्य वाक्यं मधुरस्वभावम्। तारा गतार्थे मनुजेन्द्रकार्ये विश्वासयुक्तं तमुवाच भूयः। ५०॥
en: Hearing the sweet words of Lakşmaņa consonant with piety and wealth, Tārā again addressed him about Räma's business, yet remaining unaccomplished with words inspiring confidence.

sa: ततः समुत्थाय कुले कुले ते राजन्यवैश्या वृषलाश्च विप्राः। अयूयुजन्नुष्ट्ररथान् खरांश्च नागान् हयांश्चैव कुलप्रसूतान्॥
en: Thereat rising, Rājanyas and Vaisyas, and Vņşalas; and Vipras in every house began to yoke camels and cars and mules and elephants and excellent steeds.

sa: अवृक्षं कामशैलं च मानसं विहगालयम्। न गतिस्तत्र भूतानां देवानां न च रक्षसाम्॥
en: (Then is) the treeless Manasa-abode of birds-the scene of Kāma's austerities. Way there is none for creatures, or for gods, or for Raksasas.

sa: क्रुद्धे तस्मिंस्तु काकुत्स्थे सुग्रीवे च सलक्ष्मणे। गतानामपि सर्वेषां तत्र नो नास्ति जीवितम्॥
en: On that Kākutstha being wrought up with wrath, as well as Sugrīva together with Lakş maņa, we, repairing thither, shall lose our lives.

sa: राक्षसानामयं वासो घोराणां कामरूपिणाम्। प्रासादाग्राणि रम्याणि नगरोपवनानि च॥ सम्पन्नानि सुगन्धीनि युक्तान्याचरितुं त्वया।
en: This is the abode of terrible Rākşasas wearing shapes at will. Picturesque palaces, prosperous cities and sweet-smelling gardens are worthy of your abode.

sa: रामस्य तु वचः श्रुत्वा मुनिवेषधरं च तम्। समीक्ष्य सह भाभी राजा विगतचेतनः॥
en: Hearing Rāma's words, and seeing him dressed like an ascetic, the king in the midst of his wives was deprived of his senses.

sa: न खल्वहं त्वां तुलये नावमन्ये न भीषये। कर्मभिस्तस्य भीमैश्च कातर्य जनितं मम॥
en: I do not compare you with Vāli, nor do I disregard or frighten you—forsooth have I greatly been alarmed by his terrible actions.

sa: गिरिजालावृतान् देशान् मार्गित्वा दक्षिणां दिशम्॥ वयं सर्वे परिश्रान्ता न च पश्याम मैथिलीम्।
en: Having explored the South, (containing) countries enveloped with mountain chains, we have all got fatigued, but we have failed to find Mithila's daughter.

sa: सा तस्मिन् पतिता पुण्या पुण्ये रुद्रस्य मूर्धनि॥ हिमवत्प्रतिमे राम जटामण्डलगह्वरे। सा कथंचिन्मही गन्तुं नाशक्नोद् यत्नमास्थिता॥ नैव सा निर्गमं लेभे जटामण्डलमन्ततः। तत्रैवाबभ्रमद् देवी संवत्सरगणान् बहून्॥
en: O Rāma, as that sacred one plunged upon Rudra's holy head of tangled locks, resembling Himavat she could by no means reach the earth, despite all her endeavours; nor did she obtain egress from under the matted locks. And she wandered there for many a year.

sa: ततोऽहं तत्र निक्षिप्तो गुहद्वारि विनीतवत्। न च निष्क्रामते वाली तदा संवत्सरे गते॥
en: And I was made to stand at the mouth in humble guise; nor did Väli issue out, although a good year rolled away.

sa: तीरं तु समनुप्राप्य नावं हित्वा नरर्षभः। प्रातिष्ठत सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या च परंतपः॥
en: Going to the (other) bank of the stream, that best of men, and subduer of foes stood along with his brother and Vaidehī.

sa: कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम पिता त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति। महिष्यापि हि कैकेय्या गम्यतां तत्र मा चिरम्॥
en: Oh, Rāma, great son of Kausalyā, your father and the queen Kaikeyi want to see you; so it behove you to go there without delay.

sa: राज्यं च सुमहत् प्राप्य तारां च रुमया सह। मित्रैश्च सहितस्तस्य वसामि विगतज्वरः॥
en: And obtaining the spacious kingdom along with Tãrã and Umā, I began to pass my days in peace in company with his counsellors.

sa: यावत् तं नहि पश्येयं तव भार्यापहारिणम्। तावत् स जीवेत् पापात्मा वाली चारित्रदूषकः॥
en: So long as you did not see that stealer of your wife, so long only shall the impious Väli of vile character, live.

sa: प्रदक्षिणेनातिबलेन पक्षिणा जटायुषा बुद्धिमता च लक्ष्मण। भवाप्रमत्तः प्रतिगृह्य मैथिली प्रतिक्षणं सर्वत एव शङ्कितः॥
en: Do you stay here, O Lakşmaņa, with Jānakī in constant fear and vigilance, along with the mighty Jațāyu, intelligent and ever engaged in pious offices.

sa: न सत्यं दानमानौ वा यज्ञो वाप्याप्तदक्षिणः। तथा बलकराः सीते यथा सेवा पितुर्मता॥
en: Truth, almsgiving, honour, and sacrifices with profuse gifts are not so strengthening (in life to come) as the service rendered to the parents.

sa: गृधं च निहतं दृष्ट्वा हृतां श्रुत्वा च मैथिलीम् ॥ राघवः शोकसंतप्तो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः।
en: And beholding the vulture slain and learning of the kidnapping of Mithila's daughter, the descendant of Raghu, deprived of sense, bewailed in grief.

sa: तां कथां श्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरेण च मैथिलि। यथाभूतं च कात्स्येन तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: O Maithili, that story I should like to hear, related at length. It therefore, behoves you to relate that to me in detail.

sa: ततः स वरदः साधू राजानं प्रत्यभाषत। म्रियतां ध्वंसतां वेयं मा शंसीस्त्वं महीपते॥
en: Thereupon that boon-giving saint said to the king; “Whether this one kills herself or be destroyed, do you not, O king, reveal it."

sa: नात्र शक्यं बलं ज्ञातुं तव वा तस्य वाधिकम्। आर्दै शुष्कमिति ह्येतत् सुमहद् राघवान्तरम्॥
en: And unable am I to ascertain who is the mightier? There is a good deal of difference, O Rāghava, between a body, wet and dried.

sa: सूत यद्यस्ति ते किंचिन्मयापि सुकृतं कृतम्। त्वं प्रापयाशु मां रामं प्राणाः संत्वरयन्ति माम्॥
en: O charioteer, if I have ever done you any good do you immediately take me to Rāma: my life urges me on (in this direction).

sa: मणिरत्नं सुवर्णं वा गावो यद्वा समुद्यतम्। तत् प्रयच्छ नृपश्रेष्ठ धरण्या न प्रयोजनम्॥
en: Do you confer upon us gems, or gold, or kine, or anything else, for, O foremost of monarchs, we do not want earth.

sa: सा तु सत्यवती पुण्या सत्ये धर्मे प्रतिष्ठिता। पतिव्रता महाभागा कौशिकी सरितां वरा॥
en: And that virtuous Kausiki, Satyavati, as well established in religion as truth, and chaste, and eminently pious, is now the foremost of streams.

sa: युधाजित् प्राप्य भरतं सशत्रुघ्नं प्रहर्षितः॥ स्वपुरं प्राविशद् वीरः पिता तस्य तुतोष ह।
en: And having Bharata as well as ſatrughna, the heroic Yudhājit, with a delighted heart, entered his own city; and his father rejoiced exceedingly.

sa: स तद् गृह्य हरिश्रेष्ठः कृत्वा मूर्ध्नि कृताञ्जलिः। वन्दित्वा चरणौ चैव प्रस्थितः प्लवगर्षभः॥
en: Thereupon, taking that (ring), and raising his joined palms to his head, that foremost and best of monkeys, saluting (Rāma's) feet, went away.

sa: तद् गच्छ त्वरितं सूत राजपुत्रं यशस्विनम्। राममानय भद्रं ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
en: Go you therefore speedily, O charioteer, and bring Rāma here, the praiseworthy son of king. This will do you good, do not hesitate in this.

sa: बहवो दुर्लभाश्चैव ये त्वया कीर्तिता गुणाः। मुने वक्ष्याम्यहं बुद्ध्वा तैर्युक्तः श्रूयतां नर।७।।
en: Rare as are the qualities mentioned by you, I will, O sage, having duly considered, describe to you a person endued with them.

sa: हितार्थमेतदुक्तं वः क्रियतां यदि रोचते। उच्यतां हि क्षमं यत् तत् सर्वेषामेव वानराः॥
en: I tell you this for your good. Act accordingly, if you list. And do you also express what else you are capable of.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तामशुचिं शक्रः पादयोः कृतमूर्धजाम्। शिरः स्थाने कृतौ पादौ जहास च मुमोद च॥
en: And thereupon seeing her resting her feet at the place where she should place her head, and consequently unclean, Śakra was exceedingly delighted, and smiled.

sa: इहैव सह वैदेह्या मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ लक्ष्मण। यावज्जानाम्यहं व्यक्तं क्व एष द्युतिमान् रथे॥
en: O Laksmana, stay here awhile with Vaidehi, so long as I do not gather who it is that is in the effulgent car.

sa: कौसल्या चैव राजा च तथैव जननी मम। नाशंसे यदि ते सर्वे जीवेयुः शर्वरीमिमाम्॥
en: I do not expect that either Kausalyā or the king or my mother is alive. If they live, it can be for this night only.

sa: ये हयाः पुरुहूतस्य पुरा शक्रस्य नः श्रुताः। अन्तरिक्षगता दिव्यास्त इमे हरयो ध्रुवम्॥
en: The steeds standing in the sky are for certain those of which we had formerly heard as beionging to Sakra of many sacrifices.

sa: न ते मनुष्या देवास्ते ये चारुशुभकुण्डलम्॥ मुखं द्रक्ष्यन्ति रामस्य वर्षे पञ्चदशे पुनः।
en: Those are not men, those are gods who in the fifteenth year shall again behold Rāma's countenance graced with elegant and burnished ear-rings.

sa: स तं वृक्षं समासाद्य संध्यामन्वास्य पश्चिमाम्। रामो रमयतां श्रेष्ठ इति होवाच लक्ष्मणम्॥
en: Having taken refuge under the tree and performed his evening devotions, that foremost of those capable of charming others. Rāma, addressed Laksmana, saying.

sa: तां नयेन च सम्पन्नो धर्मेण विनयेन च। उवाच राजा कैकेयीं समीक्ष्य व्यथितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Endowed with a sense of justice and with virtue and humility, the king with afflicted senses steadily eyeing Kaikeyī, thus spoke to her.

sa: इयं सा प्रथमा यात्रा पार्थिवानां नृपात्मज। न च पश्यामि सुग्रीवमुद्योगं च तथाविधम्॥
en: O son of king, this is the best time for royal marches, but I do not find Sugrīva preparing himself for that end.

sa: श्रृणु चाप्यपरं भूयः कारणं हरिपुंगव। तच्छ्रुत्वा हि महद् वीर न मन्यु कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Hearken, O best of monkeys, there is another argument (for your destruction); and hearing which, O great hero, it behoveth you to renounce your ire.

sa: सत्यरूपं तु तद् वाक्यं राजस्त्रीणां निशामयन्। प्रदीप्त इव शोकेन विवेश सहसा गृहम्॥
en: Having heard those words of the queens, fraught with truth, Sumantra burning as it were in grief, at once entered the (next) apartment.

sa: यथैव राजा पूज्यस्ते गौरवेण तथा ह्यहम्। त्वां साहं नानुजानामि न गन्तव्यमितो वनम्॥
en: As the monarch is worshipful to you in veneration so am I. I do not permit you, to repair hence to the forest.

sa: हा कौसल्ये न पश्यामि हा सुमित्रे तपस्विनि। हा नृशंसे ममामित्रे कैकेयि कुलपांसनि॥
en: O Kausalyā, I do not see. O wretched Sumitrā! O cruel one, you enemy of mine, you Kaikeyī, who have befouled your line!

sa: तपसा ये च तीव्रण त्यजन्तीह कलेवरम्। तत् स्थानं समासाद्य श्रीमन्तो भान्ति नित्यशः॥२२
en: Those also that give up their lives after undergoing severe ascetic penances go to the same region and shine brightly there for ages.

sa: तः प्रीतमना भूत्वा स एनां ब्राह्मणोऽब्रवीत्। प्रीतोऽस्मि परमं भद्रे परिचारेण ते शुभे॥
en: That Brahmana, then, with a joyful heart said to her “O gentle and graceful maid, I have been highly pleased with your ministrations.

sa: तस्मिस्तथा मया शस्ते यदि द्रौणायनी रुषा। कुरुते भैरवं नादं तत्र किं मम हीयते॥
en: Upon the punishment of Drona, (which he richly deserved), if his son, out of anger, utier such loud roars, what do I lose by them?

sa: त्वया हि कथितं पूर्वं युद्धाभ्यागता वयम्। घटामहे यथाशक्तिं त्वं तु नोऽद्य जुगुप्ससे॥
en: You had said before "Addressing ourselves in battle. we shall exert to the utmost of our abilities." But now you are reproaching us.

sa: कृतवर्मा कृतस्तेन धरणीमन्वपद्यत। तस्मिन् सात्यकिना वीरे द्वैरथे विरथीकृते॥ समपद्यत सर्वेषां सैन्यानां सुमहद् भयम्।
en: The heroic Kritavarman, having been deprived of his car by Satyaki in that single combat, all the (Kaurava) soldiers were possessed by a great fear.

sa: न क्षस्यति पिता पुत्रं पुत्रश्च पितरं तथा। भार्याश्च पतिशुश्रूषां न करिष्यन्ति संक्षय॥
en: Fathers will not forgive their sons and the sons will not forgive their fathers; at this time wives will not serve their husbands.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं स पाण्डवस्तेन अनुनीतो महात्मना। विशोको विज्वरो राजन् काम्यके न्यवसत् तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus, O monarch, instructed by that highsouled one ((Markandeya), the Pandava (Yudhishthira) devoid of grief and affliction continued to dwell in Kamyaka.

sa: अपराधो न चास्माकं यत् ते द्यूते पराजिताः। अजेया जयतां श्रेष्ठ पार्थाः प्रताजिता वनम्॥
en: It is not our fault that defeated at another game of dice-those invincible sons of Pritha-those foremost among victors were thus exiled into the forest.

sa: पार्षतस्य क्षमं त्वं वै क्षमतां पार्वतश्च ते॥ वयं क्षमयिताश्च किमन्यत्र शमाद् भवेत्।
en: Forgive the son of Prisata, let him also forgive you. We will also practise forgiveness. What other virtue can be equal to forgiveness!

sa: स भवानीदृशं मित्रं मन्यते च यथा भवान्॥ भवन्तश्च यथास्माकं भवतां च तथा वयम्।
en: You are a dear friend to this prince and even such is he to you. You are to us even as we are to you.

sa: ब्राह्मणः कुरुते तद्धि यथा यद् यच्च वाञ्छति। बह्वीस्तु संविशन् योनीर्जायमानः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Passing through numberless orders of being and undergoing repeated rebirths, one succeeds in some subsequent birth in acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana.

sa: इच्छन्नेव हि सम्बन्धं कृतं पूर्वं च मानयन्। को हि नाम भवेनार्थी साहसेन समाचरेत्॥
en: Even if one desires to have such an alliance, who is there who desiring happiness will act so rashly remembering the services he has received?

sa: अर्थसिद्धेः परं धर्मं मन्यते यो महीपतिः। वृद्ध्यां च कुरुते बुद्धिं स धर्मेण विराजते॥
en: That king who considers Righteousness as the most effectual instrument for accomplishing his objects, and who follows the advice of the righteous, shines with righteousness.

sa: प्रेतकार्याणि च तथा चकार सह बान्धवैः। पाण्डवानां तथा क्षत्ता भीष्मश्च कुरुसत्तमः :॥
en: He performed the last rites of the Pandavas with his friends and relatives, with Kshatta (Vidura) and that foremost of the Kurus, Bhishma.

sa: एकं प्रहारं यं दद्यां भीमाय रुषितो नृप। स एवैनं नयेद् घोरः क्षिप्रं वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: Being enraged, the one blow that I shall deal Bhima, o king, will strike him severely and speedily send him to the palace of death.

sa: स तदा तद् वचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजस्य धीमतः। तान् निवर्तध्वमित्याह न न्यवर्तन्त चापि ते॥
en: Remembering these behest's of king Yudhishthira the just who was gifted with great intelligence, Arjuna asked the Trigartas to forbear. But they disregarded Arjuna's injunction.

sa: आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो त्वमेनं राक्षसोत्तमम्। यं दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे भयार्ता विद्रुता दिशः॥
en: O mighty-armed one, tell me all about this foremost of Rākşasas, seeing whom the monkeys, overwhelmed with fear, fly away in all directions.

sa: न त्वां जरा वा रोगो वा वैवयं चापि भाविनि।।४६ स्प्रक्ष्यन्ति पुण्यगन्धा च कृष्णमाराधयिष्यसि।
en: Every one will see you engaged in waiting upon Krishna, possessed as you already are with a fragrant odor which is always present in you.

sa: यदा समं कपोतेन तव मांसं नृपोत्तम। तदा देयं तु तन्मह्यं सा मे तुष्टिर्भविष्यति॥
en: O excellent king, when you flesh would be equal in weight with this pigeon, give it then to me and I shall be then satisfied.

sa: श्रुतं हि धर्मशास्त्रेषु पठ्यमानं द्विजातिभिः। तथा त्वमपि कल्याणि गदतो मे वचः शृणु॥
en: Hear, O auspicious girl, as I tell you the words, which I have heard the twice-born ones to recite from the sacred books.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य सर्वस्य वर्तमानाः प्रतिग्रहे। केन विप्रा विशेषेण तारयन्ति तरन्ति च॥
en: Yudhishthira said : By what means do the Brahmanas, who receive gifts from all the four orders, save others as well as themselves?

sa: त्वं हंसः सविता भानुरंशुमाली वृषाकपिः। विवस्वान् मिहिरः पूषा मित्रोधर्मस्तथैव च॥ सहस्ररश्मिरादित्यस्तपनस्त्वं गवाम्पतिः। मार्तण्डोऽर्को रविः सूर्यः शरण्यो दिनकृत् तथा॥ दिवाकरः सप्तसप्तिर्धामकेशी विरोचनः। आशुगामी तमोघ्नश्च हरिताश्वश्च कीर्त्यसे॥
en: You are Hansa, you are Savitri, you are Bhanu, Anshumali, Vrishakapi, Vivasvana, Mihira, Pusha, Mitra and Dharma. You are thousand-rayed sun, you are Tapana, the lord of rays. You are Martanda, Arka, Ravi, Surya, Sharanga, the maker of the day. Dibakara, Saptasapti, Dhamakeshin, Virochana, Ashugami, Tamoghna and Haritashva.

sa: को हि राधासुतं कर्णं शक्तो योधयितुं रणे। अन्यत्र रामाद् द्रोणाद्वा पाण्डवाद्वा किरीटिनः॥
en: Who is capable of fighting with the son of Radha, Karna, in battle except Rama, Drona or Kiriti, the son of Pandu (Arjuna)?

sa: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन्नवहितो यथावृत्तो महान् क्षयः। कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च समासाद्य परस्परम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Hear, O king, attentively how that great thousands of the Kurus and the Pandavas took place when they encountered each other.

sa: विजयस्य च तत् कर्म गान्धारविषये तदा। श्रुत्वा चान्येषु देशेषु स सुप्रीतोऽभवत् तदा॥
en: Hearing also the feats, performed by Vijaya in the country of the Gandharas as also in other kingdoms, the king became highly pleased.

sa: जवेनाभ्यपतन् हृष्टा नन्तो दौर्योधनं बलम्॥ तस्याश्ववाहान् सुवहूंस्ते निहत्य शितैः शरैः। तमन्वधावंस्त्वरितास्तत्र युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Having slain with keen the numerous cavalry of Shakuni, those Pandava heroes quickly proceeded against Shakuni himself, whereupon a fierce encounter took place.

sa: विभज्य ब्रह्महत्यां तु वृक्षेषु च नदीषु च। पर्वतेषु पृथिव्यां च स्त्रीषु चैव युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Then, O Yudhishthira was the crime of slaying that Brahmana divided among the trees, the rivers and the mountains and the world and the women.

sa: प्रख्यातास्तेऽर्जुनं वीरं हनिष्यन्ति च मा शुचः। असपत्ना त्वया हीयं भोक्तव्या वसुधा नृप॥
en: These illustrious warriors will kill the heroic Arjuna. Do not therefore grieve. O king, you will rule the whole earth without a rival.

sa: प्रावेपत भयोद्विग्ना प्रवाते कदली यथा। प्रणम्य सा हि ब्रह्माणं शिरसा तु कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Literally trembled with fear as the plantain tree does during a storm and bowing her head to Brahma and clasping her hands together.

sa: सोऽहं शरीरजे दत्त्वा कीर्ति प्राप्स्यामि शाश्वतीम् दत्त्वा च विधिवद् दानं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो यथाविधि।॥ हुत्वा शरीरं संग्रामे कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्। विजित्य च परानाजौ यशः प्राप्स्यामि केवलम्॥
en: So, I will win an everlasting renown by giving (my car-rings) born with my body. By duly bestowing on the Brahmanas (gifts) sanctioned by ordinances, by sacrificing my life in battle on performing unachievable feats and by conquering my enemies I will win nothing but fame.

sa: विविध्यं निहतं दृष्ट्वा तां च विक्षोभितां चमूम्। कामगेन स सौभेन शाल्वः पुनरुपागमत्।॥
en: Seeing Vivindha killed and his army (very much) agitated, Shalva came back again on his (car) Saubha, capable of going everywhere at will.

sa: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः। भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि॥
en: Amongst men none can be dearer to Me than such a man. None on earth can do Me greater service also than he.

sa: पश्य शैनेय सैन्यानि द्रवमाणानि संयुगे। महान्तं च रणे शब्दं दीर्यमाणां च भारतीम्॥
en: Behold, O grandson of Sini, the Bharata troops are broken and flying away; and as they fly, hear the loud wails they utter.

sa: नृपे शान्तगुणे जाते कौसल्यां पतितां भुवि। अपश्यंस्ताः स्त्रियः सर्वा हतां नागवधूमिव ॥
en: And when the king had departed this life, the women saw Kausalyā fallen on the earth like the slain mate of an elephant.

sa: न योक्ष्यति हि मे शीलं तव भृत्यैः पुरातनैः। ते त्वां विभेदयिष्यन्ति दुःशीलाश्च मदन्तरे॥
en: My conduct, again, my not be like that your old servants. If they be of wicked conduct, they will create disunion between you and me.

sa: होत्रवाहन उवाच रामं द्रक्ष्यसि भद्रे त्वं जामदग्न्यं महावने। उग्रे तपसि वर्तन्तं सत्यसंधं महाबलम्॥
en: Hotravahana said “You will see Rama, the son of Jamadagni, devoted to truth and endued with great strength in the great forest, practicing hard asceticism.

sa: अकृतव्रण उवाच भवन्तमेव सततं रामः कीर्तयति प्रभो। सृञ्जयो मे प्रियसखो राजर्षिरिति पार्थिव॥
en: Akritavrana said Rama ever speaks of you, my lord, saying: The royal sage Srinjaya, that ruler of the earth, is my dear friend.

sa: यत् तु मां भगवान् रामो वक्ष्यति द्विजसत्तम। तन्मे कार्यतमं कार्यमिति मे भगवन् मतिः॥
en: 0 best among the twice-born, it is my opinion that what the lord Rama points out to me would be my supreme duty, my lord.

sa: न हि पश्याम्यहं तं वै त्रिषु लोकेषु कंचन। क्रुद्धस्य भीमसेनस्य यस्तिष्ठेदग्रतो रणे॥
en: O Sanjaya, I do not find that warrior in the three worlds, who can, stand before Bhimasena when he is excited with rage.

sa: प्रासादो धर्षितश्चैत्यः प्रवरा राक्षसा हताः। आविला च पुरी लङ्का सर्वा हनुमता कृता॥
en: He has shattered the palace, and the altar of sacrifice, slain the leading Raksasas, and, in short, agitated the whole city of Lankā.

sa: स तु तीत्वर्णिवं रामः सह वानरसेनया। प्रतिजानामि ते सत्यं न जीवन्प्रतियास्यति ॥
en: And although Rāma has crossed the ocean along with the monkey-army, yet I swear to you truly, living, he shall not back hence.

sa: सदा सुखमहं मन्ये यं पुरा सह सीतया। मारुतः स बिना सीतां शोकसंजननो मम।।५४
en: That breeze appears painful to me in Sītā's absence which ere this, had been regarded by me as a source of pleasure in her company.

sa: सोऽथ श्रुत्वैव तद् वाक्यं तस्या राजा स्मरन्नपि। अब्रवीन्न स्मरामीति कस्य त्वं दुष्टतापसि॥
en: Having heard her words, the King remembered everything, but he said, “I remember nothing. O wicked ascetic woman, to whom do you belong?"

sa: पुत्राम्नो नरकाद् यस्मात् पितरं त्रायते सुतः। तस्मात् पुत्र इति प्रोक्तः स्वयमेव स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: Because the son rescues his ancestors from the hell, called Put, therefore he has been called by the self-created (Brahma) himself as Putra.

sa: समागम्य च राज्ञा ते राजपुत्रेण चार्चिताः। राज्ञः पादौ गृहीत्वा च तमूचुर्भरतं वचः॥
en: Presenting themselves before the king, they, well received by him as well as the prince, bowed down to the feet of the monarch.

sa: एष ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च शिवश्चैव जगत्पतिः। सोमश्च भगवान् देवः सर्वे च परमर्षयः॥
en: See, there are Brahma and Vishnu, and Shiva, that lord of the universe, the illustrious and divine Soma, and all the great Rishis.

sa: माकार्षीः कश्मलं शक्र कश्चिदेवेतरो यथा। आर्यां युद्धे मतिं कृत्वा जहि शत्रून् सुराधिप॥
en: Do not, O Indra, yield to weakness, like an ordinary mortal! Firmly determined on battle, kill your enemies, O king of the gods.

sa: तत्कुम्भकर्णस्य भुजप्रणुन्नं शूलं शितं काञ्चनदामयष्टिम्। क्षिप्रं समुत्पत्य निगृह्य दोभ्या बभञ्ज वेगेन सुतोऽनिलस्य॥
en: Then swiftly bounding up, the Wind-god's son, resisting that whetted dart fastened with golden chains, with his hands violently snapped it in twain.

sa: तां तु विद्रवतीं दृष्ट्वा ऊचतुः केशवार्जुनौ। मा विद्रवत वित्रस्ता भयं त्यजत पाण्डवाः॥
en: beholding their troops fly away Kesava and Arjuna then addressed them thus-'Do you not flight from fear! Discard all your fears, O Pandavas.

sa: तस्याहं पदवीं यास्ये संदेशात् तव मानद। त्वत्कृते न च मे किंचिदकर्तव्यं कथंचन॥
en: O bestower of honor, with your permission, I will follow his track. There is nothing that I shall not do for your sake.

sa: यथा हि मे गुरोर्वाक्यं विशिष्टं द्विपदां वर। तथा तवापि वचनं विशिष्टतरमेव मे॥
en: 0 best of men, the commands of my preceptor are ever worthy of my attention. But your words are all the more so.

sa: यदि वो रोचते वृत्तं जनकस्य महात्मनः। पुरीं गच्छामहे शीघ्रं मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः॥
en: If this alliance with the high-souled Janaka is relished by you, we shall speedily repair to his capital. Let there be no waste of time.

sa: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः। सत्त्व प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात् त्रिभिर्गुणैः॥
en: There is none, either among the beings on earth or among be celestial in heaven, which is free from these three qualities born of Nature.

sa: न प्रवेक्ष्यामि वो देशं विरुद्धं यदि मानुषैः। युधिष्ठिराय यत् किंचित् करपण्यं प्रदीयताम्॥
en: If this country is shut against human beings, I shall not enter it. Let something be given by you as tribute to Yudhishthira.

sa: नास्ति तस्मात् परोऽन्यो हि पिता देवोऽथवा द्विज। आत्मा हि नः स विज्ञेयस्ततस्तं पूजयावहे॥
en: There is no higher god, or father than He, O twice-born one! He should be known as our Soul. It is Him that we adore.

sa: सावित्रः कुण्डलं दिव्यं यानं च जनमेजयः। ब्राह्मणाय च गा दत्त्वा गतो लोकाननुत्तमान्॥
en: King Janamejaya of the solar race, went to the highest heaven by making a gift of earrings, fine vehicles and cows to Brahmanas,

sa: सा पपात त्रिधा च्छिन्ना भूमौ कनकभूषणा॥ शीर्यमाणा यथा दीप्ता गगनाद् वै शतह्रदा।
en: Cut off into piece that golden dart fell down on the earth like a burning thunder-bolt from the sky sending forth many flashes.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच य एष राजन् राजेति शब्दश्चरति भारत। कथमेष समुत्पन्नस्तन्मे ब्रूहि परंतप॥
en: Yudhishthira said Whence came the word Rajan, O king, that is used, O Bharata, on Earth? Tell me this, O scorcher of foes.

sa: गच्छेदानीं न ते स्थानमनृतस्येह विद्यते। न त्वया सदृशो युद्धे भविता क्षत्रियो भुवि॥
en: Go hence, this is not the place for a person who behaves falsely. On Earth, no Kshatriya will be your equal in battle.

sa: न चैव विवृतो मन्त्रः पृथायास्तस्य वा विभो॥ अथ शूरो महेष्वासः पार्थेनाजौ निपातितः।
en: Neither Pritha, nor he, had ever divulged the secret, O Sir! That hero and great bowman, was therefore killed by Arjuna in battle.

sa: तानत्तिं पुरुषः सर्वान् पश्य कालो यथागतः। प्राणस्यान्नमिदं सर्वं जङ्गमं स्थावरं च यत्॥
en: Behold, all things again are eaten up by the Destroyer when he comes! This mobile and immobile universe is food for living creatures.

sa: यं पुरोधाय कुरव आह्वयन्ति स्म पाण्डवान्। सोऽयं शस्त्रभृतां श्रेष्ठो द्रोणः शस्त्रैः परिक्षतः॥
en: Placing him at their head, the Kauravas had challenged the Pandavas. That foremost of all warriors was in the end wounded with weapons.

sa: वारयामास यः सर्वान् पाण्डवान् पुत्रगृद्धिनः। स हत्वा विपुला: सेनाः स्वयं मृत्युवंश गतः॥
en: After killing a vast army, he who had restrained all the Pandavas desirous of rescuing their son, at last himself yielded to death.

sa: दुःशलां मानयद्भिस्तु तदा मुक्तो जयद्रथः। कथमद्य न तां कृष्ण मानयन्ति स्म ते पुनः॥
en: Out of respect, for Dusshala, they liberated him on that occasion. Why, O Krishna, did they not show some respect for that Dusshala once more.

sa: दुर्मरं पुनरप्राप्ते काले भवति केनचित्। यदहं त्वां रणे दृष्ट्वा हतं जीवामि दुर्भगा॥
en: Until the appointed time comes, one cannot die, since, wretched that I am, I am still alive after seeing you killed in battle.

sa: यदा न भावं कुरुते सर्वभूतेषु पापकम्। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा॥
en: When one does not commit sin by any creature, in deed, thought, or word, one is then said to have attained to Brahma.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तामुवाचाथ गान्धारी सह बध्वा यशस्विनीम्॥ मैवं पुत्रीति शोकार्ता पश्य मामपि दुःखिताम्।
en: Seeing that illustrious lady with her daughter-in-law, Gandhari said, 'Do not, O daughter, grieve so. See, I too am much afflicted with sorrow as you.

sa: न मामर्हसि गान्धारि दोषेण परिशङ्कितुम्। अनिगृह्य पुरा पुत्रानस्मास्वनपकारिषु। अधुना किं नु दोषेण परिशङ्कितुमर्हसि॥
en: You should not, O Gandhari, attribute any fault to me. Without having checked your sons formerly, should you attribute any fault to our innocent selves.

sa: रुधिरं न व्यतिक्रामद् दन्तोष्ठं मेऽम्ब मा शुचः। वैवस्वतस्तु तद् वेद हस्तौ मे रुधिरोक्षितौ॥
en: The blood, however, did not, O mother, pass down my lips and teeth. Karna knew this well. My hands only were covered with Dussasana's blood.

sa: वैरस्यास्य गताः पारं हत्वा दुर्योधनं रणे। राज्यं युधिष्ठिरः प्राप्तो वयं च गतमन्यवः॥
en: Having killed Duryodhana in battle, we have terminated our hostilities. Yudhishthira has regained his kingdom, and we also have been freed from anger!'

sa: यत्र सूर्य उदेति स्म यत्र च प्रतितिष्ठति। सर्वं तद् यौवनाश्वस्य मान्धातुः क्षेत्रमुच्यते॥
en: The whole Earth from the point from which the Sun rises to where he sets is said to be the field of Mandhatri.

sa: व्यास उवाच धृतराष्ट्रो महाबाहो यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु। श्रुतवानसि मेधावी धर्मार्थकुशलः प्रभो॥
en: Vyasa said O mighty-armed Dhritarashtra, hear what I say. You are learned, intelligent, and you O powerful, one, are skilled in understanding duties.

sa: तमुवाचा ततो दृष्ट्वा पर्वतं नारदस्तथा॥ कृताञ्जलिमुपासीनं दीनं दीनतरः स्वयम्। त्वयाहं प्रथमं शप्तो वानरस्त्वं भविष्यसि॥ इत्युक्तेन मया पश्चाच्छप्तस्त्वमपि मत्सरात्। अधप्रभृति वै वासं स्वर्गे नावाप्स्यसीति ह॥ तव नैतद्धि विसदृशं पुत्रस्थाने हि मे भवान्। न्यवर्तयेतां तौ शापावन्योन्येन तदा मुनी॥
en: Seeing the cheerless Parvata kneeling before him with joined palms, Narada, himself more disspirited, said to him.-You had cursed me first, saying,-Be you a monkey!-After you had said so to me, I cursed you from anger, saying,-From this day you will not live in heaven. You should not have done so, since you are like a son to me.-The two saints then released each other from their mutual curses.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच सुभाषितैर्महाप्राज्ञ शोकोऽयं विगतो मम। भूय एव तु वाक्यानि श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said "O you of great wisdom, by grief has been removed by your excellent words. I wish you, however, to speak again.

sa: काल: पचति भूतानि कालः संहरते प्रजाः। कालः सुप्तेषु जागर्ति कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः॥
en: Time makes all creatures grow, and it is Time that destroys all. When all else is asleep, Time is awake. Time is irresistible.

sa: स त्वं राजेन्द्र संजातं शोकमेनं निवर्तय। यथा त्वां केशवः प्राह व्यासश्च सुमहातपाः॥
en: Do you, O foremost of kings, remove this grief of your heart, as Keshava has advised you, as also Vyasa of austere penances.

sa: शतं वै यस्तु काम्बोजान् ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रयच्छति। नियतेभ्यो महीपाल स च पापात् प्रमुच्यते॥
en: That man, o king, who gives away a hundred horse of the Kamvoja breed to Brahmanas of regulated conduct, becomes freed from sin.

sa: वयमेव त्रयो राजन् गच्छन्तं परमां गतिम्॥ यद् वै त्वां नानुगच्छामस्तेन धक्ष्यामहे वयम्।
en: Because we three, O king, do not follow you who are about to achieve the highest end (of life), we are bewailing thus.

sa: कृपस्य तव वीर्येण मम चैव पितुश्च मे॥ सभृत्यानां नरव्याघ्र रत्ववन्ति गृहाणि च।
en: through you the houses of Kripa, of myself, and of my father, as well as those of our dependents, are full of riches.

sa: इयमेनं गदा शूरं न जहाति रणे रणे। स्वर्गायाति व्रजन्तं हि न जहाति यशस्विनम्॥
en: In no battle did that mace leave this hero! Even now, when is about to go to heaven, that weapon abandons not this illustrious hero.

sa: सर्वस्य हि स्वका प्रज्ञा साधुवादे प्रतिष्ठिता। परबुद्धिं च निन्दन्ति स्वां प्रशंसन्ति चासकृत्॥
en: Every one praises his own wisdom. Every one speaks ill of the wisdom of others, and well of his own, in all cases.

sa: अर्हस्त्वं भीष्म मां द्रष्टुं तपसा स्वेन पार्थिव। तव ह्युपस्थिता लोका येभ्यो नावर्तते पुनः॥
en: Through your own penances, O Bhishma, you are competent to see me. Those regions from which no one returns, O King, are ready for you.

sa: मा भवन्तो तप्यन्तां सौहृदानिधनेन मे। यदि वेदाः प्रमाणं वो जिता लोका मयाक्षयाः॥
en: Do not, from love grieve for me death! If the Vedas are in any way authoritative, I have certainly acquired many eternal regions!

sa: सर्वेषां दीप्तयशसां कुरूणां धर्मचारिणाम्। यस्य नास्ति समः कश्चित् स मां पृच्छतुं पाण्डवः॥४
en: Let the son of Pandu, who has no peer among all the Kurus, among all righteous persons and among celebrated men question me.

sa: न संत्याज्यं च ते धैर्य कदाचिदपि पाण्डव। धीरस्य स्पश्दण्डस्य न भयं विद्यते क्वचित्॥
en: You should never, O son of Pandu, abandon fortitude. The king who is crowned with fortitude and who punished wrong-doers, has no cause of fear.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच किमर्थं द्विजशार्दूलं धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। गान्धार्याः प्रेषयामास वासुदेवं परंतपम्॥ यदा पूर्वं गतः कृष्णः शमार्थं कौरवान् प्रति। न च तं लब्धवान् कामं ततो युद्धमभूदिदम्॥
en: Janamejaya said “Why did that best of kings, viz., the righteous Yudhishthira, send that scorcher of foes, viz., Vasudeva, to Gandhari? Krishna had at first gone to the Kauravas for the sake of bringing about peace. He was not successful. For this the battle took place.

sa: योऽस्य वै मुखमद्राक्षीत् सौम्यं सोऽस्य वशानुगः। सुभगं चार्थवन्तं च रूपवन्तं च पश्यति॥
en: He who once beheld Prithu's sweet face, became obedient to him. Thenceforth he began to know him as handsome, wealthy and highly blessed.

sa: मुष्टिं मुष्टिं ततः सर्वे दर्भाणां ते छुपाहरन्। तस्यासनार्थं विप्र लस्यापि वशे स्थिताः॥
en: Obeying that beautiful Rishi though a boy, the ascetics each brought a handful of grass and offered it to him for his seat.

sa: तस्यास्थिभिरथो शक्रः समप्रहृष्टमनास्तदा। कारयामास दिव्यानि नानाप्रहरणानि च॥ गदावज्राणि चक्राणि गुरून् दण्डांश्च पुष्कलान्।
en: With his bones, Shakra gladly made many kinds of weapons, such as thunder-bolts, disci, heavy maces and many kinds of clubs and bludgeons.

sa: तां दिव्यवपुषं दृष्ट्वा तस्य वितात्मनः। रेतः स्कन्नं सरस्वत्यां तत् सा जग्राह निम्नगा॥
en: Seeing that beautiful damsel the seminal fluid of thar ascetic came out. Having fallen into the Sarasvati, the latter preserved it with care.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पार्थिवेन विशेषेण किं कार्यमवशिष्यते। कथं रक्ष्यो जनपदः कथं जेयाश्च शत्रवः॥
en: Yudhishthira said 'What other special duties remain for the king to satisfy? How should he protect his kingdom and how vanquish his foes.

sa: एते गुणाः समस्ताः स्युपस्य सततं स्थिराः। व्यवहारलोपे नृपतेः कुतः स्वर्गः कुतो यशः॥
en: All these qualities should always be in a king. If the king fails to administer justice, he can neither acquire heaven nor fame.

sa: भीष्म उवाच महाभाग्यं दण्डनीत्याः सिद्धः शब्दैः सहेतुकैः। शृणु मे शंसतो राजन् यथावदिह भारत॥
en: Bhishma said Listen to me, O king, as I describe, O Bharata, the great virtues of the science of punishment in weighty and sacred words.

sa: यथा त्वया महाभागे मदर्थं संशितव्रते। विशेषो हि त्वया भद्रे व्रते ह्यस्मिन् समर्पितः॥
en: Thus the pure-souled Arundhati, formerly, obtained the highest success, like you, O highly blessed lady, for my sake, O damsel of rigid Vows!

sa: भीष्म उवाच ह्रीनिषेवास्तथा दान्ताः सत्यार्जवसमन्विताः। शक्ताः कथयितुं सम्यक् ते तव स्युः सभासदः॥
en: Bhishma said Such persons as are endued with modesty, self-control, truth, sincerity, and courage to say the proper thing, should be your law-makers.

sa: पूज्यमाना मुनिगणैर्वल्कलाजिसंवृत्तैः। मनोरमेति विख्याता सा हि तैर्मनसा कृता॥ सुरेणर्ऋषभे द्वीपे पुण्ये राजर्षिसेविते।
en: Worshipped of all those Munis clad in barks and deer-skins, she passed by the name of Manorama as those Rishis mentally called her.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच सप्तसारस्वतं कस्मात् कश्च मङ्कणको मुनिः। कथं सिद्धः स भगवान् कश्चास्य नियमोऽभवत्॥
en: Janamejaya said "Why was that tirtha called Sapta-Sarasvat? Who was the ascetic Mankanaka? How was that worshipful one successful? What were his vows and observances?

sa: तयोश्चिन्ता समभवद् दृष्ट्वा पशुगणं महत्॥ कथं च स्युरिमा गाव आवाभ्यां हि विना त्रितम्।
en: Sceing that large herd of animals they began to think as to how they two could appropriate that property without giving a share to Trita.

sa: तत्र दत्त्वा बहु द्रव्यं पूजयित्वा तथा द्विजान्। उपस्पृश्य च तत्रैव प्रहृष्टो मुसलायुधः॥
en: Having distributed profuse wealth and worshipped the Brahmanas, the hero, having the plough for his weapon, bathed there and was filled with joy.

sa: इयं च पृथिवी सर्वा सम्लेच्छाटविका भृशम्। प्रसादाद् भियते यस्य प्रत्यक्षं तव संजय॥
en: You have with your own eyes, O Sanjaya, seen the whole earth, with even her Mlecchas and nomad tribes, depend upon his grace.

sa: संजय उवाच दुर्योधनं तव सुतं सलिलस्थं महायशाः। श्रुत्वा तु करुणं वाक्यमभाषत युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Sanjaya continued Hearing those words of piercing anguish, the illustrious Yudhishthira said to your son Duryodhana who was still within the lake, saying-

sa: यस्तु योधः परावृत्तः संत्रस्तो हन्यते परैः॥ अप्रतिष्ठः स नरकं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः।
en: That infamous warrior, who retreating from the fight in fear, is killed by foes, sinks into hell. There is no doubt in this.

sa: उदीर्णमनसो योधा वाहनानि च भारत। यस्यां भवन्ति सेनायां ध्रुवं तस्यां परो जयः॥
en: That army in which the troops and the animals are all hearty and cheerful, O Bharata is sure to gain a decided success.

sa: भूत्वा च न भवत्येतदभूत्वा च भविष्यति। शोके न ह्यस्ति सामर्थ्यं शोकं कुर्यात् कथंचन॥
en: Things that were, are no more. Things that are, will again be no more. Grief cannot restore them. One should not, therefore, succumb to grief.

sa: भवेत् सत्यं न वक्तव्यं वक्तव्यमनृतं भवेत्। यत्रानृतं भवेत् सत्यं सत्यं वाप्यनृतं भवेत्॥
en: There, where falsehood prevails as truth, truth should not be said. There, again, where truth passes for falsehood, even falsehood should be said.

sa: अनन्तरं च निहते द्रोणे ब्रह्मविदां वरे। राधेये च विकर्णे त नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: After that when Drona, that foremost of Brahmanas, as fell, as also the son of Radha and Vikartana, the battle did not stop.

sa: हते भीष्मे तु संदध्याच्छिवं स्यादिह माधव। न च तत् कृतवान् मूढो धार्तराष्ट्रः सुबालिशः॥
