en: If peace had been made after Bhishma's fall, O Madhava, everything would have fared well. The foolish and wicked-minded Duryodhana, however, did not make peace.

sa: प्राकृतो हि प्रशंसन् वा निन्दन वा किं करिष्यति। वने काक इवाबुद्धिर्वाशमानो निरर्थकम्॥
en: What can a vulgar person do by either his praise or blame? He is like a crow that caws uselessly in the forest.

sa: न संधातुमनीकानि न च राजन् पराक्रमे। आसीद् बुद्धिर्हते शल्ये भूयो योधस्य कस्यचित्॥
en: After the fall of Shalya, O king, none amongst your troops had the mind of either rallying the army or displaying his prowess.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच वार्यमाणा मया पूर्वं नैते चक्रुर्वचो मम॥ एते विनिहताः सर्वे प्रस्कन्नाः पाण्डुवाहिनीम्।
en: Duryodhana said Though prevented by me before, they did not carry our my order. These men, in a body, have entered into the Pandava army.

sa: दण्डो हि भगवान् विष्णुर्दण्डो नारायणः प्रभुः। शश्वद् रूपं महद् बिभ्रन्महान् पुरुष उच्यते॥
en: Punishment is the holy Vishnu. He is the powerful Narayana. And because he always puts on dreadful from, therefore he is called Mahapurusha.

sa: न स्याद् यदीह दण्डो वै प्रमथेयुः परस्परम्। भयाद् दण्डस्य नान्योन्यं मन्ति चैव युधिष्ठिर॥
en: If punishment had not existed, all creatures would have struck one another. Through fear of punishment, O Yudhishthira, living creatures do not kill one another.

sa: ततो भयं प्रादुरासीत् प्रह्लादस्य महात्मनः॥ अपृच्छत् स ततो भूयः क्व यासि कमलालये।
en: The great Prahlada, stricken with fear, once more asked the goddess, saying,-Where do you go, O goddess, O you that live amid lotuses?

sa: यदन्येषां हितं न स्यादात्मनः कर्म पौरुषम्। अपत्रपेत वा येन न तत् कुर्यात् कथंचन॥
en: That act or exertion which does not do good to other, or that act for which one has to feel shame, should never be done.

sa: त्वं हि प्रष्टा च श्रोता च कृच्छ्रेष्वनुगतेष्विह। श्रुत्वा मम महाराज न संतप्तुमिहार्हसि॥
en: Stricken with distress you have questioned me and heard my answer. Fiaving heard it, O monarch, you should remove these regrets of yours.

sa: संजय उवाच तत् प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा मद्रराजः प्रतापवान्। उवाच सारथिं तूर्णं चोदयाश्वान्महाजवान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding the army thus scattered the brave king of the Madras address his driver, saying-Quickly urge these horses fleet as thought.

sa: कथं रणे हतः शल्यो धर्मराजेन संजय॥ भीमेन च महाबाहुः पुत्रो दुर्योधनो मम।
en: How, O Sanjaya, was Shalya killed by the . righteous king Yudhishthira? And how was my son Duryodhana slain by the powerful Bhimasena?

sa: कथं च वः समेतानां मद्रराजो महारथः। निहतः पाण्डवैः संख्ये पुत्रो वा मम संजय॥
en: How, when all of you were together, could the mighty king of the Madras, as also my son, be slain, O Sanjaya, by the Pandavas?

sa: विग्रहं केन वा कुर्यात् संधिं वा केन योजयेत्। कथं वा शत्रुमध्यस्थो वर्तेत बलवानपि॥
en: With whom should he make war and with whom should he make peace? Even if he be strong, how should he act by his foes?

sa: न ते सौम्य भयं कार्यं जीविष्यसि यथासुखम्। अहं त्वामुद्धरिष्यामि यदि मां न जिघांससि॥
en: O amiable one, you have no cause for fear. You will live in happiness! I shall save you, If, indeed, you do not kill me.

sa: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च सर्वे ते निहता नृप। दुर्योधनो हतो राजा यथोक्तं पाण्डवेन ह॥
en: All the kings and princes have been killed. The king Duryodhana too has been killed by Pandu's son (Bhima) as he had promised.

sa: लीनं तु तस्य गात्रेषु मार्जारस्य च मूषिकम्। दृष्ट्वा तौ नकुलोलूको निराशौ प्रत्यपद्यताम्॥
en: Seeing him thus enclosed within the body of the cat, the mongoose and the owl both gave up hopes of catching their prey.

sa: कृत्वा बलवता संधिमात्मनं यो न रक्षति। अपथ्यमिव तद् भुक्तं तस्य नार्थाय कल्पते॥
en: The person that does not protect himself after having made an agreement with a stronger individual, sees that is yields instead of good.

sa: ब्रवीषि मधुरं यच्च प्रियो मेऽद्य भवानिति॥ तन्मित्र कारणं सर्वं विस्तरेणापि मे शृणु।
en: You speak sweetly that I am very dear to you. Hear me, however, O friends, the reasons which I have on my side.

sa: ब्रह्मदत्त उवाच कालेन क्रियते कार्य तथैव विविधाः क्रियाः। कालेनैते प्रवर्तन्ते कः कस्येहापराध्यति॥
en: Brahmadatta said It is Time that does every work. There are various sorts all of which proceed form Time. Who, therefore, injures whom?

sa: संजय उवाच एवं ब्रुवति पुत्रे ते सैनिकां भृशविक्षताः। अनवेक्ष्यैव तद्वाक्यं प्राद्रवन् सर्वतो दिशः॥
en: Sanjaya said Though your son gave vent to those words the Kuru soldiers greatly wounded fled away on all sides caring not for his speech.

sa: तव पुत्रो ममापत्यं हतवान् स हतो मया। अनन्तरं त्वयाहं च हन्तव्या हि नराधिप॥
en: Your son killed my child. I have injured him for that. I have by inat act, o king, become liable to be killed by you.

sa: साश्वं तु कर्ण सरथं किरीटी समाचिनोद भारत वत्सदन्तैः। प्रच्छादयामास दिशश्च बाणैः सर्वप्रयत्नापनीयपुकैः॥
en: Then Kiritin, O descendant of Bharata, covered Karna, his car and horses with calftoothed arrows and the ten quarters with gold winged ones.

sa: पुनश्च कर्णं त्रिभिरष्टभिश्च द्वाभ्यां चतुर्भिर्दशभिश्च विद्ध्वा॥ चतुःशतान् द्विरदान् सायुधान् वै हत्वा रथानष्टशताञ्जघान्।
en: Again striking Karna with three, eight, twelve, four and ten shafts he put four hundred armed elephants and eight hundred carwarriors to death.

sa: यथा प्रज्वलितः सूर्यो युगान्ते वै वसुंधराम्॥ दीप्यन् दृश्येत हि तथा केतुः सर्वत्र धीमतः।
en: That banner of the most intelligent Partha appeared like the burning sun when at the end of a Yuga, it rises to consume the earth.

sa: माधवस्तु भृशं विद्धो राक्षसेन रणे तदा। वार्यमाणश्च तेजस्वी जहास च ननाद च॥
en: Then that powerful descendant of Madhu's race also, though deeply pierced by Rakshasa, depending on his own energy, smiled and uttered his war-cry.

sa: ततः सा पुनरेवाथ कन्या रुद्रमुवाच हा उपपद्येत कथं देव स्त्रिया युधि जयो मम॥
en: “Thereupon again she said to Rudra, How can it happen, that mine shall be the victory in battle, O god, as I am, a woman?

sa: उभो तौ रथिनां श्रेष्ठावुभौ भारत दुर्जयौ॥ उभी चन्द्रार्कसदृशौ कान्त्या दीप्त्या च भारत।
en: Both of them were excellent car-warriors, both were invincible, O Bharata, and both resembled the moon and the sun in splendor and beauty.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच मृत्यो संकल्पितासि त्वं प्रजासंहारहेतुना। गच्छ संहर सर्वास्त्वं प्रजा मा ते विचारणा॥
en: Brahma said You have been created, O Death, for causing the destruction of creatures; go, destroy all the creatures; entertain no scruples whatsoever.

sa: त्वय्येवैतद् युक्तरूपं महत् कर्म धनंजय। प्रीतोऽस्मि सुभृशं पुत्र कुरु युद्धं मया सह॥
en: O Dhananjaya, such a great feat is indeed worthy of you. I have been pleased with you. O son, fight hard with me”.

sa: एवं सा निश्चयं कृत्वा भृशं शोकपरायणा। निर्जगाम गृहं त्यक्त्वा गहनं निर्जनं वनम्॥
en: Having firmly taken this resolution and been deeply afflicted with grief, she went out to a deep and lonely forest, abandoning her house.

sa: उत्तमास्त्राणि चाधत्स्व गृहीत्वा च महद् धनुः। पार्षतं याहि राजानं युध्यस्व च वृकोदरम्॥
en: Make your excellent weapons ready, grasp your mighty bow, and then rush against the royal son of Prishata and fight also with Vrikodara.

sa: स त वैकर्तनः कर्णः सामात्यः सह बन्धुभिः। न्यासितः समरे शस्त्रं भीष्मेण भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the son of Vikartana Karna, with his friends and relatives, however, laid aside his weapons of Bhishma.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः संशप्तका राजन् समे देशे व्यवस्थिताः। व्यूह्यानीकं रथैरेव चन्द्राकारं मुदा युताः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O monarch, the Samsaptakas, filled with joy, stood on the level plain, having, with their chariots, formed an array figuring the moon.

sa: शजयं चन्द्रकेतुं मेघवेगं सुवर्चसम्॥ सूर्यभासं च पञ्चैतान् हत्वा विव्याध सौबलम्। तं सौबलस्त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा दुर्योधनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Then having slain Satrunjaya, Chandraketu, Meghavega, Suvarchasam and Suryabhasa, he pierced the son of Subala. Subala then piercing him with three arrows, thus addressed Duryodhana-

sa: प्रतिज्ञाय वधं जिष्णो पुरा भीष्मस्य संयुगे। क्षत्रधर्मे स्थितः पार्थ कथं नैनं हनिष्यसि॥
en: O Vishnu, having promised to slay Bhishma in battle, how can you desist from slaying him without transgressing the duties of a Kshatriya?

sa: तं चैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे सात्यकिं रभसं रणे! परिवार्य स्थिताः संख्ये समन्तात् सुमहौजसः॥
en: In the same manner, the Pandavas endued with great might, speedily forming themselves in a circle round Satyaki, stood (ready) in that battle.

sa: यस्मिन् सत्यं च मेधा च नीतिश्च भरतर्षभे। अप्रमेयाणि दुर्धर्षे कथं स निहतो युधि॥
en: There were truth, intelligence and policy to an immeasurable extent in that irresistible chief of the Bharata race. How could he be killed in battle?

sa: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः। वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता॥
en: The man of Yoga solely depends upon Me, keeping all his senses under control. His mind is steady who has controlled his senses.

sa: निहनिष्यामि तरसा तस्य कालोऽयमागतः। त्वं हि भोज्ये पुरस्कार्यो भक्ष्ये पेये च भारत॥
en: I shall soon slay, the time for that is now come. You can indeed be rewarded in matters of dishes-both meats and drinks.

sa: निर्विष्णोऽस्मि भृशं तात देहेनानेन भारत। घ्नतश्च मे गतः कालः सुबहून् प्राणिनो रणे॥
en: O Bharata, O sire, I am disgusted with this body of mine. I have passed my days in slaying numerous creatures in battle.

sa: ततो जघान समरे वृत्रं देवपतिः स्वयम्। तं च मन्त्रमयं बन्धं वर्म चाङ्गिरसे ददौ॥
en: Then the lord of the celestials slew Vritra in battle and gave afterwards that armour of which the joints were composed of Mantras, unto Angiras.

sa: द्रोणेन चैवमुक्तस्य तव पुत्रस्य भारत। सहसा निःसृतो भावो योऽस्य नित्यं हदि स्थितः।।१३
en: ( Bharata, when your son had been thus addressed by Drona, the feeling that was then present in his heart, suddenly round vent.

sa: कर्मैतत् पार्थ शक्रेण यमेन धनदेन च। दुष्करं समरे यत् ते कृमद्येति मे मतिः॥
en: 'I think, O Partha, the feat you have today achieved in battle is difficult of being performed even by Indra or Yama or Kubera himself.

sa: तद् वृथा च सभामध्ये वल्गितं ते वृकोदर। उलूक नकुलं ब्रूहि वचनान्मम भारत॥
en: The boast you indulged in at that assembly is false, O Vrikodara. O Uluka, on my behalf do you also speak to Nakula.

sa: स तैः परिवृतः शूरैः शूरो युधि सुदुर्जयैः। न स्म प्रव्यथते राजन् कृष्णतुल्यपराक्रमः॥
en: O king, being as invincible and powerful as Krishna himself, that hero, being thus surrounded by those heroes, was not the least agitated.

sa: केतुं विपतितं दृष्ट्वा श्रुतायुः स तु पार्थिवः। पाण्डवं विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णै राजन् विव्याध सप्तभिः॥
en: Then that ruler of earth Shrutayush, beholding his standard felled, pierced, O king, the son of Pandu with seven arrows of great sharpness.

sa: न द्वितीयां प्रतिज्ञां हि प्रतिजानामि कैतव। सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहं ह्येतत् सर्वं सत्यं भविष्यति॥
en: O gambler's son, I do not know how to make a second resolve. I tell you the truth, all this will truly happen."

sa: अजानात् स यदा तु त्वां राजधर्मादधश्च्युतम्। तदाप्रभृति कृष्णस्त्वां न तथा बहु मन्यते॥
en: But when he came to know you fallen from the duties of royalty, that time forward, he did not respect you as before.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः। अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः॥
en: Arjuna said Then, O descendant of Vrishni, by whom impelled does man commit sin, though unwilling, as if driven by (some mysterious) force?

sa: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धि यजन्त इह देवताः। क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा॥
en: Desiring success of actions, men worship the Celestial (such as Indra &c.), for in this world the success of action is soon attained.

sa: भीष्मो वः समरे सर्वान् पालयिष्यति धर्मवित्। ते भयं सुमहत् त्यक्त्वा पाण्डवान् प्रति युध्यत॥
en: The valiant Bhishma conversant with all duties will protect us in battle.” Then those troops of yours dismissing all fears fought on with the Pandavas.

sa: स एकः समरे तस्थौ किरन् बहुविधाञ्शरान्। भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैः शेषा हि प्रद्रुता नराः॥
en: Susharına alone, accompanied by his brother, was standing against Arjuna in battle, scattering various kinds of shafts, the rest of his men having ran away.

sa: तवैव दोषाद् दुर्बुद्धे सर्वमेतत् त्वनावृतम्। स गच्छ मा चिरं तात उलूक यदि मन्यसे॥
en: Of course, I shall have to approve of the doings of these followers. There do you go without delay, O Uluka, if you wish it,

sa: यात्रायाने च युद्धे च तथा प्रशमनेषु च। भृशं वेद महाराज यथा वेद बृहस्पतिः॥
en: In the matter of marching out troops in fighting and in declaring war I am as much an adept, O great king, as Brihaspati himself.

sa: सहदेव उवाच अस्मिन् रणसमूहे वै वर्तमाने महाभये। उत्सृज्य क्क नु गन्तासि शत्रूनभिमुखो नृप॥
en: Sahadeva said o kin, when these hostile troops, both numerous and terrible, stand here to fight with us, where do you go to their directions?

sa: अर्जुन उवाच किं ते व्यवसितं राजन् यदस्मानपहाय वै। पद्भ्यामेव प्रयातोऽसि प्राङ्मुखो रिपुवाहिनीम्॥
en: Arjuna said O king, what is this you are doing that abandoning us you proceed on foot, face eastwards to the enemy's army.

sa: ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय भीष्मः शान्तनवो युधि॥ श्वेतं विव्याध राजेन्द्र कङ्कपत्रैः शितैः शरैः। ततः सेनापतिः क्रुद्धो भीष्मं बहुभिरायसैः॥ विव्याध समरे राजन् सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः। ततः प्रव्यथितो राजा भीष्मं दृष्ट्वा निवारितम्॥ । प्रवीरं सर्वलोकस्य श्वेतेन युधि वै तदा। निष्ठानकश्च सुमहांस्तव सैन्यस्य चाभवत्॥ तं वीरं वारितं दृष्ट्वा श्वेतेन शरविक्षतम्। हतं श्वेतेन मन्यन्ते श्वेतस्य वशमागतम्॥
en: Then the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, took up another bow in that battle and wounded Shveta with arrows, furnished with the feather of Kanka birds. Then that commander (Shveta) in great anger wounded Bhishma in that battle with innumerable arrows in the very sight of all. Seeing Bhishma, that foremost of all the warriors, checked in the battle by Shveta the king (Duryodhana) became exceedingly cheerless, and your whole army felt themselves in great distress. Seeing the heroic Bhislima checked and wounded by Shveta with his arrows, a!' thought that Bhishma had been killed.

sa: न च सोऽप्यस्ति ते योधः सर्वराजसु भारत। द्रोणं यः समरे यान्तं नानुयास्यति संयुगे॥
en: O Bharata, there is not even a single warrior among this mighty host of kings, who will not follow Drona when he goes to fight.

sa: अदेशिको यथा सार्थः सर्वः कृच्छ्रे समृच्छति। अनायका तथा सेना सर्वान् दोषान् समर्छति॥
en: Just as a foreign trader in an unknown country reaps all distress, so an army without a commander is exposed to all dangers.

sa: धात्रीणां च सखीनां च वीडमाना न्यवेदयत्। कन्यां पञ्चालराजस्य सुतां तां वै शिखण्डिनीम्॥
en: Represented to her nurses and lady companions with shame (this fact) about the maiden daughter of the king of the Panchalas, viz. Shikhandin.

sa: किं नु मे हृदयं त्रस्तं वाक् च सज्जति केशव। स्यन्दन्ति चाप्यनिष्टानिगात्रं सीदति चाप्युत॥
en: “Why, O Keshava, does my mind misgive and why does my speech falter? Evil portents reveal themselves to me and my limbs are becoming weak.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच मुखवर्णोऽप्रसन्नो वः सर्वेषामेव लक्ष्यते। न चाभिमन्यु पश्यामि न च मां प्रतिनन्दथ॥
en: Arjuna said I see that the colour of your countenances has turned pale. I do not also see Abhimanyu here, nor do you welcome me.

sa: ताः प्रकामं रुदित्वा च विलय च सुदुःखताः। उन्मत्तवत् तदा राजन् विसंज्ञा न्यपतन् क्षितौ॥
en: Then copiously lamenting and bewailing under the weight of their grief, they fell down, Oking, on the earth, senseless and like so many mad creatures.

sa: व्यास उवाच खरा गोषु प्रजायन्ते रमन्ते मातृभिः सुताः। अनार्तवं पुष्यफलं दर्शयन्ति वनदुमाः॥
en: Vyasa said Asses are being born of cows. Sons hold sexual intercourse with their mothers. The forest trees produce unseasonable flowers and fruits.

sa: यत् पार्थेन प्रतिज्ञातं तत् तथा न तदन्यथा। चिकीर्षितं हि ते भर्तुर्न भवेज्जातु निष्फलम्॥
en: What the son of Pritha has vowed shall be accomplished and cannot be otherwise. What your husband has set his heart upon, cannot remain undone.

sa: स कृत्वा दुष्करं कर्म हत्वा वीरान् सहस्रशः। षट्सु वीरेषु संसक्तो दौःशासनिवशं गतः॥
en: Having achieved many difficult feats and having slain thousands of warriors, Subhadra's, son encountered six warriors simultaneousiv At last succumbing to Dushasana's son.

sa: तथा कुरुत कौरव्या यथा वः सात्यको युधि। न जीवन् प्रतिनिर्याति महतोऽस्माद् रथव्रजात्॥
en: “Do you all so strive, O Kurus, that this Satyaki may not return back with his life from this mighty host of chariots.

sa: न सूतेषु न धुर्येषु न च शस्त्रोपनायिषु। न भेरीशङ्खवादेषु प्रहर्तव्यं कथंचन॥
en: Charioteers, animals, men engaged in carrying weapons, those who play on drums and those who blow conchs should never be smitten.

sa: उत्सृज्य तुरगान् केचिद् रथान् केचिच्च मारिष। गजानन्ये समुत्सृज्य प्राद्रवन्त दिशो दश॥
en: Some leaving their horses, some their cars, and some their elephants. O sire, fled in all the directions of the compass.

sa: विजयाद् यदनुप्राप्तं माधवेन यशस्विना। तदस्त्रं भस्मसात् कृत्वा मायां तां राक्षसीं तदा॥
en: Which that renowned scion of Madhus race had obtained from Vijaya himself. That weapon then reducing into ashes the Rakshasis illusion,

sa: यः शक्तः समरे भीष्मं प्रतियोद्भुमिहाहवे। ऋते त्वां पुरुषव्याघ्र सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Who is able to fight with Bhishma in battle, except yourself, O best of men? This I say to you forsooth."

sa: संजय उवाच अर्जुनस्तु रणे शल्यं यतमानं महारथम्। छादयामास समरे शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Sanjaya said Arjuna covered over with his arrows of straight knots that mighty car-warrior Shalya who had been fighting very carefully.

sa: विदुरेणाथ भीष्मेण द्रोणेन च महात्मना। तथा मया चाप्यसकृद् वार्यमाणो न बुध्यसे॥
en: Always forbidden by Vidura, Bhishma, Drona of high soul, his son, as also by me, you did not pay any regard.

sa: नाभिमन्युमपश्यन्त नैव स्वान् न परान् रणे। अभिमन्युश्च तद् दृष्ट्वा घोररूपं महत्तमः॥
en: And none was able to discern Abhimanyu, or his friends or enemies. Then, beholding that palpable darkness of great fearfulness, Abhimanyu,

sa: योधयिष्यामि सैन्यानि नाशयन् सर्वसोमकान्। न च मां पाण्डवा युद्धे योधयिश्यन्ति हर्षिताः॥
en: I shall encounter the hostile array and kill the Somakas. In battle, the Pandavas will not meet me with delightful hearts.

sa: क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत् त्वय्युपपद्यते। क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परंतप॥
en: Be not effeminate, Partha. It does not suit you. Arise, O terror of foes, shake off this mean weakness of heart.

sa: ऊऊस्तम्भः समभवद् वेपथुः स्वेद एव च। सर्व एव महाराज तावका दीनचेतसः॥
en: Their thighs were petrified and they trembled and perspired; and O foremost of kings, all of them became depressed at heart.

sa: तद् घोरमभवद् युद्धं तस्य तेषां च भारत। खलीनान्यथ योक्त्राणि कक्ष्याश्च कनकोज्ज्वलाः॥ परिस्तोमाश्च प्रासाश्च ऋष्टयश्च महाधनाः। कवचान्यथ चर्माणि चित्राण्यास्तरणानि च॥ तत्र तत्रापविद्धानि व्यदृश्यन्त महाहवे।
en: O sire, that battle was fought between him and those soldiers was exceedingly fearful. Hilts, traces, golden saddles girths, covers for the horses, bearded darts costly swords, armours, shields, and beautiful ornaments, were seen by us strewn over the ground in that great battle.

sa: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्। इन्द्रियार्थान् विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते॥
en: The deluded man, who, controlling his organs of actions, ponders in his mind over the objects of senses, is a hypocrite.

sa: पृष्ठं भीमस्य रक्षन्तः शरवर्षेण वारणान्। अभ्यवर्षन्त धावन्तो मेघा इव गिरीन् यथा॥
en: Supporting Bhima's car, proceeded behind him, checking the foe with their shower of arrows, like clouds drenching the mountains with rain.

sa: पाण्डवा हि ततो राजन्श्रुत्वा तं निनदं महत्। दध्मुः शङ्खांश्च भेरीश्च मुरजांश्चाप्यनादयन्॥
en: O king, having heard the loud uproar, the Pandavas blew their conchs and ordered their drums and cymbals to be sounded.

sa: तथैव कुरवी राजन् भीष्मं कृत्वा महारथम्। अग्रतः सर्वसैन्यानां प्रययुः पाण्डवान् प्रति॥
en: The Kauravas also, O king, placing at the van of all their troops the mighty car-warrior Bhishma, advanced against the Pandavas.

sa: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः। क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत॥
en: As the single sun, O Bharata, lights up all this entire world, so Purusha lights up the entire sphere of matters.

sa: एतत् परमकं गुह्यमेतत् परमकं पदम्। एतत् परमकं ब्रह्म एतत् परमकं यशः॥
en: He is the supreme mystery; he is the supreme shelter; he is the supreme Brahma, and he is the supreme glory.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो रजन्यां व्युष्टायां शब्दः समभवन्महान्। क्रोशतां भूमिपालानां युज्यतां युज्यतामिति॥
en: Sanjaya said When the night passed away loud was the noise made by the kings by their all shouting "Array, array".

sa: हया गजैः समाजग्मुः पादाता रथिभिः सह। अन्योन्यं समरे राजन् प्रार्थयानाः समभ्ययुः॥
en: Horse-soldiers encountered elephant-riders and foot-soldiers fought with the car-warriors; challenging one another in battle they rushed against one another, O king.

sa: पपात पुष्पवृष्टिश्च भीष्मस्योपरि मारिष॥ न च तच्छुश्रुवे कश्चित् तेषां संवदतां नृप।
en: And, O sire, over Bhishma fell a shower of blossoms. As those Rishis and Vasus spoke, O king, none heard then.

sa: सोऽभिवाद्य कृपं राजा कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। उवाच दुर्धर्षतमं वाक्यं वाक्यविदां वरः॥
en: Bowing down to Kripa and walking round him, O king, Yudhishthira, accomplished in speech, thus spoke to that greatly brave warrior.

sa: एवमेतं महाव्यूह प्रत्यव्यूहन्त पाण्डवाः॥ वधार्थं तव पुत्राणां तत्पक्षं ये च सङ्गताः।
en: It was thus the Pandavas formed their Vyuha for the destruction of your sons and those who have taken your side.

sa: के तं यान्तमनुप्राप्ता के वास्यासन् पुरोगमाः। केऽतिष्ठन् के न्यवर्तन्त केऽन्ववर्तन्त संजय॥
en: When he advanced who followed him and who went in front? Who stood by his side and who advanced with him?

sa: नोत्सहे तु पुनर्गन्तुं स्वजनं प्रति तापसाः। प्रत्याग्याता निरानन्दा शाल्वेन च निराकृता॥
en: I do not venture to go back to my kindred, O devctees, rejected and rendered cheerless and y. nged by Shalva.

sa: ततः प्रवृत्तः सुमहान् संग्राम: शोणितोदकः। तावकानां च समरे पाण्डवानां च भारत।॥
en: Then commenced a sanguinary engagement between your warriors and those of the Pandavas, in which blood flowed like streams of water.

sa: सा पूर्वे कौशिकी पुण्यां जगाम नियमैघिता। तत्र वायुजलाहारा चचार नियमं पुनः॥
en: Then observant of her vows, she first visited the sacred Kousiki; living upon air and water only, she practised penances there.

sa: तत्र तत्र च संग्रामे दुर्योधनहितैषिणा। बहवश्च जिताः कर्ण त्वया वीरा महौजसा॥
en: O Karna, desirous of doing good to Duryodhana, you defeated in battle in various lands, O hero, numerous highly vigorous clans.

sa: प्रमृद्य च रणे सेनां पद्मिनी वारणो यथा। ततोऽभिदुद्राव रणे द्रौपदेयान् महाबलान्॥
en: Thus crushing the troops in battle bike an elephant crushing a lotus, that highly puissant Rakshasas rushed against the sons Draupadi.

sa: एकादश समाख्याता अक्षौहिण्यश्च या मम। निदेशे तव तिष्ठन्ति मया सार्धं परंतप॥
en: My troops counting eleven Akshauhini in number, as also my own self, O grinder of foes, are all under your command.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो रजन्यां व्युष्टायां शब्दः समभवन्महान्। क्रोशतां भूमिपालानां युज्यतां युज्यतामिति॥
en: Sanjaya said When the night passed away loud was the noise made by the kings by their all shouting "Array, array".

sa: विवस्वान् भगवान् स्वस्ति करोतु तव सर्वशः। दिग्गजाश्चैव चत्वारः क्षितिश्च गगनं ग्रहाः॥
en: May the illustrious Vivasvat bless you today! May the four elephants guarding the cardinal points, the earth, the firmament, the planets.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच भारतस्यास्य वर्षस्य तथा हैमवतस्य च। प्रमाणमायुषः सूत बलं चापि शुभाशुभम्॥ अनागतमतिक्रान्तं वर्तमानं च संजय। आचक्ष्व मे विस्तरेण हरिवर्षं तथैव च॥
en: Dhritarashtra said 0 Sanjaya, O Suta, tell me in detail the length of life, the strength, the good and bad things, the past, present and future of the dwellers of the Bharata Varsha and of the Himavat Varsha and also of Harivarsha.

sa: सा वध्यमाना समरे पुत्रस्य तव वाहिनी। लोड्यते रथिभिः श्रेष्ठस्तत्र तत्रैव भारत॥
en: Thus the army of your son being thus slaughtered, the foremost of car-warriors began, O Bharata, to betray sings of agitation.

sa: एवं ते वध्यमानाश्च हतशेषा महागजाः। प्राद्रवन्त दिशो राजन् विमृदन्तः स्वकं बलम्॥
en: Thus slaughtered, the surviving remnant of that huge elephant division ran away in all directions, O king, crushing their own ranks.

sa: वीणा नैवाद्य वाद्यन्ते शम्यातालस्वनैः सह। मङ्गल्यानि च गीतानि च गायन्ति पठन्ति च॥ स्तुतियुक्तानि रम्याणि ममानीकेषु बन्दिनः। योधाश्चापि हि मां दृष्ट्वा निवर्तन्ते ह्यधोमुखाः॥
en: The melodious Venu is not played upon accompanied by claps; auspicious songs, fraught with praises and delightful, are not sung in my troops today, by the minstrels and the bards. All warriors also, beholding me, are turning away.with their faces cast down.

sa: एवं तद् राक्षसस्याङ्गं छिन्नं छिन्नं बभूव ह। इरावानपि संक्रुद्धो राक्षसं तं महाबलम्॥ परश्वधेन तीक्ष्णेन चिच्छेद च पुनः पुनः। स तेन बलिना वीरश्छिद्यमान इरावता॥
en: Thus the limbs of the Rakshasa again and again cut to pieces, appeared very beautiful. Thereupon the enraged Iravat repeatedly cut that Rakshasa endued with great strength with his battle axe of exceeding sharpness. Cut like a tree by that powerful Iravat, that heroic.

sa: विहगः सुमुखो यस्तु सुपर्णस्यात्मजः किल। स वै विचिन्तयामास सौवर्णान् वीक्ष्य वायसान्॥
en: The bird Sumukha, the son of Suparna (Garuda), seeing that all the birds on the Meru were of golden plumage, reflected.

sa: इन्द्रजालं च माया वै कुहका वाऽपि मीषणा। आत्तशस्त्रस्य संग्रामे वहन्ति प्रतिगर्जनाः॥
en: Illusion is sometimes frightful but it only inspires rage in him who has taken up arms and is ready for battle.

sa: जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये। ते ब्रह्म तद् विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्म कर्म चाखिलम्॥
en: Those, who depending on me, tries to obtain release from decay and death know Brahma, the entire Adhyatma and all actions.

sa: तं निहत्य गदाचेण स लेभे परमां मुदम्। पुत्रः पाञ्चालराजस्य महात्मा भीमविक्रमः॥
en: Thus that high-sculed Panchala prince endued with dreadful might won great fame, by thus having crushed his adversary with his club.

sa: परांश्च निर्गुणान् मन्ये न चधर्मगतानपि। ते च लोमश लोकेऽस्मिन्नृध्यन्ते केन हेतुना॥
en: O Lomasha, I think my enemies have no merit and no virtuous tendencies. Why then do they proper in this world?

sa: प्राप्य राज्यं महाराज कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। चातुर्वण्र्यं यथायोग्यं स्वे स्वे स्थाने न्यवेशयत्॥
en: Having regained his kingdom, O monarch, Kunti's son Yudhishthira made each of the four orders of men perform their respective duties.

sa: न कस्याञ्चिदवस्थायां राज्यं दास्यन्ति वै स्वयम्। भवांस्तु धर्मसंयुक्तं धृतराष्ट्र ब्रुवन् वचः॥
en: On no account whatever will they give back the kingdom voluntarily. You, too who will speak words of virtue to Dhritarashtra.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच पश्य भूतानि दुःखेन व्यतिषिक्तानि सर्वशः। उत्तमाधममध्यानि तेषु तेष्विह कर्मसु॥
en: The Brahmana said See, all creatures-the superior, the middling, and the inferiorm-on account of their respective acts, and entangled in sorrow.

sa: तद् रूपं तस्य ते दृष्ट्वा क्षत्रिया: शत्रुकर्षिणः। राक्षसं मन्यमानास्तं नयनानि न्यमीलयन्॥
en: Seeing the form of that crusher of foes, those Kshatriyas took him to be a Rakshasa and shut up their eyes.

sa: एते चान्ये च निहता बहवः क्षत्रियर्षभाः। प्रातिकामी तथा पापो द्रौपद्याः केशकृद्धतः॥
en: These and many other leading Kshatriyas, as also Pratikamin, that wretch who had seized the locks of Draupadi, have been killed.

sa: राजा च धृतराष्ट्रोऽद्य श्रुत्वा पुत्रं मया हतम्। स्मरिष्यत्यशुभं कर्म यत् तच्छकुनिबुद्धिजम्॥
en: Today hearing of his son's death, king Dhritarashtra will remember all those wrongs that he did to us under Shakuni's advice."

sa: यत् कुमाराः कुमार्यश्च वैरं कुर्युरचेतसः। न तत् प्राज्ञोऽनुकुर्वीत न विदुस्ते बलाबलम्॥
en: Boys and girls, who are incapable of distinguishing between right and wrong, quarrel among one another. The wise never imitate them.

sa: अनित्यं यौवनं रूपं जीवितं रत्नसंचयः। ऐश्पर्य प्रियसंवासो गृध्येत् तत्र न पण्डितः॥
en: The learned men, knowing youth, beauty, life, treasure, prosperity and association with beloved ones to be (all) unstable, never covet them.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच राज्ञस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा धृतराष्ट्रस्य संजयः। उपप्लव्यं ययौ द्रष्टुं पाण्डवानमितौजसः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Sanjaya, having heard the words of king Dhritarashtra, to Upaplavya to see the sons of Pandu of illimitable strength.

sa: तृष्णा क्रोधोऽभिसंरम्भो राजसास्ते गुणाः स्मृताः। श्रमस्तन्द्रा च मोहश्च त्रयस्ते तामसा गुणाः॥
en: Cupidity, anger and hatred, these three qualitics said to belong Darkness. Lassitude, procrastination and delusion, these three qualities belong to Ignorance.

sa: तस्माद् विश्वसितव्यं च शङ्कितव्यं च केषुचित्। एषा नीतिगतिस्तात लक्ष्या चैव सनातनी॥
en: Therefore every one should be trusted as also mistrusted. This rule of policy, O sire, should always be kept in view.

sa: ततः समुदयं कृत्वा बलानां राजसत्तमः। अभियाने मतिं चक्रे दुपदं प्रति भारत॥
en: Then that best of kings, having mustered a large army, formed the resolution of marching against the king Drupada, O Bharata.

sa: ज्ञातीन् विभजतो वित्तं तदाऽऽसीत् ते मनः कथम्। यत् ते सहस्रसमिता ननृतुर्देवयोषितः॥
en: Formerly, for many years, when shining with splendour, you used to sport, thousands of celestial damsels used to dance before you.

sa: स तद् वनं व्यनुसरन् सम्प्रधावन्नितस्ततः॥ वीक्षमाणो दिशः सर्वाः शरणं व भवेदिति।
en: Entering it, he began to run hither and thither, looking every side for finding out somebody whose shelter he might seek.

sa: तस्यां चोद्धार्यमाणायां संक्षोभः समजायत। देवाः संक्षुभिताः सर्वे ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः॥ हाहाभूतमभूत् सर्वं त्रिदिवं व्योम भूस्तदा। न पर्य वस्थितः कश्चिद् देवो वा मानुषोऽपि वा॥
en: When she was thus raised up, a great agitation was created. All the celestials the Rishis and the ascetics were agitated; and the earth, the sky and the heaven were filled with “Alas! Oh!". Neither the celestials nor men could find peace.

sa: कुलं सम्प्राप्तया पुण्यं कुले महति जातया। एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही रावणं तं यशस्विनी॥ रावणं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा भूयो वचनमब्रवीत्। नाहमौपयिकी भार्या परभार्या सती तव॥
en: I am born in a high and have been married in a pious family. Having accosted Rāvana thus, the well-known Vaidehi, turning her back, again spake to him, saying. "I should not live with you since I am another's wife and chaste."

sa: करिष्यामि यथार्थं तु कण्डोर्वचनमुत्तमम्। धर्मिष्ठं च यशस्यं च स्वयं स्यात्तु फलोदये॥
en: I shall therefore follow the excellent words of Kaņdu-leading to piety, fame and the attainment of the abode of the celestials.

sa: एवं प्रायाणि युद्धानि विजयो नास्ति नैष्ठिकः। सभाग्यशेषतास्माकं यदि वीर भविष्यति॥ मोहमेतौ प्रहास्येते महात्मानौ महाबलौ। पर्यवस्थापयात्मानमनाथं मां च वानर।। सत्यधर्माभिरक्तानां नास्ति मृत्युकृतं भयम्॥
en: This is the way of warfare: victory is not (always) sure But, O hero, If Fortune ultimately smile upon us, this stupor shall go off from these high-souled and exceedingly powerful ones. therefore, O monkey, do you cheer me, who am forlorn.

sa: ततस्तु प्रघसा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ कण्ठमस्या नृशंसायाः पीडयामः किमास्यते। निवेद्यतां ततो राज्ञे मानुषी सा मृतेति ह।॥ नात्र कश्चन संदेहः खादतेति स वक्ष्यति।
en: Thereupon another Rākşasī named Praghasă and-"I shall grind the throat of this cruel woman. What are you doing, sitting here? You shall then relate to the king that the woman is dead. And undoubtedly he shall say 'Do you eat her up."

sa: स तथेति ततः कृत्वा राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। प्रीतोऽस्मि भवतो राजन्दर्शनेन नयेन च॥
en: Saying “so be it" the king Janaka bespoke Rāma “O king, I have delighted with seeing you and your courteous manners.

sa: माननीयो मम त्वं हि पालनीया तथास्मि ते। एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रत्युवाच विनीतवत्॥
en: You are worthy of being reverend by me and I am object of your protection." Being thus addressed Daśagrīva humbly replied.

sa: दिवः क्षिप्तामिवोल्कां तां शक्तिं क्षिप्तामसंगताम्। गृहीत्वा हरिशार्दूलो बभञ्ज च ननाद च॥
en: Thereat catching the dart of resistless course as it descended from the sky, the powerful monkey snapped it and then shouted.

sa: समाप्ते नियमे तस्मिंस्तत्र देवो महेश्वरः। ततः प्रीतेन मनसा प्राह वाक्यमिदं प्रभुः॥
en: On my term of restraint having been complete, that lord of the gods Maheśvara with a gratified heart addressed me, saying.

sa: स तं प्रतिभयं श्रुत्वा वधं पुत्रस्य दारुणम्॥ घोरमिन्द्रजितः संख्ये कश्मलं प्राविशन्महत्।
en: Hearing of that mighty terror, viz., the rueful and dreadful destruction of his son, "Indrajit, in battle, he straightway swooned away.

sa: दृष्ट्वा समागतं देवी हनूमन्तं महाबलम्। तूष्णीमास्त तदा दृष्ट्वा स्मृत्वा हृष्टाभवत्तदा ॥
en: Beholding the highly powerful Hanuman arrived there the worshipful dame stood silent for sometime and then recognising him became greatly delighted.

sa: राक्षसं वा मनुष्यं वा शृणुतेऽयं बलाधिकम्। रावणस्तं समासाद्य युद्धे ह्वयति दर्पितः॥
en: Rākşasas or men, of whom the proud Rävaņa heard to be powerful he used to approach and summon them for fight.

sa: बलस्य यदि चेद्धर्मो गुणभूतः पराक्रमैः। धर्ममुत्सृज्य वर्तस्व यथा धर्मे तथा बले॥
en: If virtue is a property of manliness, then carefully forsaking virtue, do you follow strength as you have hitherto followed virtue.

sa: अद्य रामस्य पश्यन्तु निधनं सुमहत्प्रियम्। लङ्कायां राक्षसाः सर्वे ये ते निहतबान्धवाः॥
en: And let those Raksasas in Lankā who have had their kindred slain (in battle), see that dear sight-Rāma slain (in fight).

sa: सीतया तव किं कार्य महेन्द्रसमविक्रम। मया सह रमस्वाद्य मद्विशिष्टा न जानकी।७८।।
en: O you that resemblest Indra the Great in prowess. Do you to-day sport with me. Janaki is not superior to me.

sa: स वृक्षेण हतस्तेन सक्रोधेन महात्मना। राक्षसो वानरेन्द्रेण पपात च ममार च॥
en: And slain with that tree by that high souled monkeys chief wrought up with passion that Raksasas fell down and died.

sa: स प्रणम्य च सुग्रीवं राघवौ च महाबलौ। वानरैः सहितः शूरैर्दिवमेवोत्पपात ह॥
en: And adoring Sugrīva and the highly powerful descendants of Raghu, he along with other heroic monkeys, leaped up in the sky.

sa: एवमेतैश्च संयुक्तो बहुभिः संयुतो मरुः। रामस्य वरदानाच्च शिवः पन्था बभूव ह॥
en: Thus did the desert come to possess these attributes; and from Rāma's bestowal of a boon, it attained a pleasant aspect.

sa: तेषां शतसहस्राणि तदा लङ्कानिवासिनाम्॥ अदहत्पावकस्तत्र जज्वाल च पुनः पुनः। सारवन्ति महार्हाणि गम्भीरगुणवन्ति च॥ हेमचन्द्रार्धचन्द्राणि चन्द्रशालोत्तमानि च। तत्र चित्रगवाक्षाणि साधिष्ठानानि सर्वशः॥ मणिविदुमचित्राणि स्पृशन्तीव दिवाकरम्। क्रौञ्चबर्हिणवर्णानां भूषणानां च निःस्वनैः।।२० नादितान्यचलाभानि वेश्मान्यग्निर्ददाह सः। ज्वलनेन परीतानि तोरणानि चकाशिरे॥ विद्युद्भिरिव नद्धानि मेघजालानि धर्मगे। ज्वलनेन परीतानि गृहाणि प्रचकाशिरे॥ दावाग्निदीप्तानि यथा शिखराणि महागिरेः।
en: That fire burnt down firm-based rich dwellings furnished with innumerable apartments, and garnished with golden Moons and crescents, and mansions having graceful crests; and variegated windows and daises raised there, embellished with rubies and lapises, and seeming to touch the Sun; and piles resembling mountains in grandeur, and resonant with the cries of Krauñas and peacocks and the tinklings of omaments. The flaming gateways all round appeared like clouds in the rainy season lighted up by lightning, or like the peaks of a mighty mountain ablaze with forest-conflagration.

sa: तत् प्रविश्य हरिश्रेष्ठ पुरीं रावणपालिताम्। विधत्स्व सर्वकार्याणि यानि यानीह वाञ्छसि ॥
en: Therefore, O best of monkeys, do you enter the city ruled by Rāvaņa; and accomplish such tasks as you wishest to.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं भूमौ राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम्। व्यथिता राक्षसाः सर्वे क्षितिकम्प इव दुमाः॥
en: Seeing that foremost of Rākşasas-Akampanaslain (and lying) on the ground, the Raksasa were extremely aggrieved, and (appeared)like trees in an earthquake.

sa: केचिद्विधा कृताः खङ्गैः स्फुरन्तः पतिता भुवि। वानरा राक्षसैः शूरैः पार्श्वतश्च विदारिताः॥
en: Some, severed in twain with swords, dropped to the earth lifeless, and monkeys were hewn in their sides by heroic Rākşasas.

sa: तानि चिच्छेद बाणौधैश्चक्राणि तु स राघवः। आयुधानि च चित्राणि रावणस्य चमूमुखे।।।।
en: Thereat Rāghava in the van of that army by means of vollies of shafts cut off Rāvana's wonderful weapons and discuses.

sa: आस्विनं च स्वनतां सिंहनादं च नर्दताम्। बभूव तुमुल: शब्दो हरीणां रक्षसामपि॥
en: And great was the uproar that arose in consequence of Rākṣasas and monkeys emitting distressful cries and sending forth leonine roars.

sa: यत्तु मां त्वमभाषिष्ठा युद्ध्यस्वेति सुरेश्वर। नाहं तं प्रतियोत्स्यामि रावणं राक्षसं युधि॥
en: O lord of celestials, even if I am requested by you. I shall not withstand the Rākşasa, Rāvana in the conflict.

sa: उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञः सीताया दर्शनं यथा। तं मणिं काञ्चनं दिव्यं दीप्यमानं स्वेतजसा ॥ दत्त्वा रामाय हनुमांस्ततः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्। समुद्रं लवयित्वाहं शतयोजनमायतम्॥ अगच्छं जानकी सीतां मार्गमाणो दिक्षया। तत्र लङ्केति नगरी रावणस्य दुरात्मनः॥ दक्षिणस्य समुस्य तीरे वसति दक्षिणे।
en: Conferring on (Rāma) the heavenly jewel set on a golden leaf and burning with its own effulgence, Hanumān, with folded hands, began-Anxious to behold Sītā, the daughter of the king Janaka, I ploughing over the main extending over a hundred Yojana, wended my way and by and by reached Lankā, the capital of the vicious-souled Rāvaņa. Lankā is situated on the southern bank of the southern ocean,

sa: तं दृष्ट्वाथ वरारोहा सीता रक्षोगणेश्वरम्। संकुच्योरू स्तनौ पीनौ बाहुभ्यां परिरभ्य च॥
en: And seeing the lord of Rākşasas the exceedingly beauteous Sītā contracted her thighs and covered her full breasts with her arms.

sa: सा त्वं भव सुविस्रब्धा अनुमानैः सुखोदयैः। अहतौ पश्य काकुत्स्थौ स्नेहादेतद्ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Do you, at this conclusion bringing in joy, take comfort; and behold the Kākutsthas unslain. This I tell you from affection.

sa: इदं तु सुमहच्चित्रं शरैः पश्यस्व मैथिलि। विसंज्ञौ पतितावेतौ नैव लक्ष्मीर्विमुञ्चति ॥
en: And behold O Maithili, this mighty wonder! These are lying insensible with arrows; but of these Grace has not taken leave.

sa: वनेचराणां सततं नूनं स्पृहयते पुरा। रामस्य दयिता चार्या जनकस्य सुता सती॥
en: Ere this, the chaste and worshipful spouse of Rāma–Janaka's daughter, used to love always the birds and animals of the forest.

sa: दृष्ट्वा त्रस्तानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च। वरदानात्तु रुद्रस्य तपसाराधितं महत्॥ तत: संकम्पते सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्। देवाः संकम्पिताः सर्वे लयं नागाश्च संगताः॥ अथ तौ मुनिशार्दूलौ ध्यानयोगादपश्यताम्। पुलस्त्यो गालवश्चैव वारयामास तं नृपम्॥ सोपालम्भेश्च विविधैर्वाक्यै राक्षससत्तमम्। तौ तु कृत्वा तदा प्रीति नरराक्षसयोस्तदा॥ संप्रस्थितौ सुसंहृष्टौ पथा येनैव चागतौ॥
en: Seeing this all animal, mobile and immobile, were stricken with terror. Thereupon trembled all the three worlds consisting of mobile and immobile begins, the celestials and all the serpents became inert. Being apprised (of this conflict) by virtue of meditation the two foremost of ascetics Pulastya and Gälava remonstrated with them in many a way and prevented the king (Māndhātā) and the foremost of Rākṣasas. Thereupon that man and demon being reconciled with one another went back by the ways they had respectively come.

sa: मोहनार्थं तु सर्वेषां बुद्धिं कृत्वा सुदुर्मतिः। हन्तुं सीतां व्यवसितो वानराभिमुखो ययौ॥
en: Desiring to charm all with his illusions, that one of wicked intent, preparing himself to slay Sītā, proceeded towards the monkeys.

sa: एवमस्त्विति तं चाह वाक्यं देवः पितामहः। मुक्तश्चेन्द्रजिता शक्रो गताश्च त्रिदिवं सुराः॥
en: Where to the grand-father replied saying "so be it." Thereupon Meghanäda released Indra and the celestials returned to their own abode.

sa: अहं हि नगरी लङ्का स्वयमेव प्लवङ्गम। सर्वतः परिरक्षामि अतस्ते कथितं मया॥
en: O monkey, I am the City of Lankā myself. I every way guard (all that is here.) that I told you.

sa: मां निहत्य किल त्वां हि निहनिष्यति राघवः। नाहमात्मनि संतापं गच्छेयं राक्षसाधिप।४।।
en: Rāghava forsooth shall slay you after slaying me But, O lord of Raksasas, I cannot come by grief (at Rāghava's hands).

sa: दुष्करं कृतवान् रामो हीनो यदनया प्रभुः। धारयत्यात्मनो देहं न शोकेनावसीदति ॥
en: Indeed my master Rāma has performed a mighty task for breathes he still in her separation, without consuming himself in grief.”

sa: रामस्तु यदि पृच्छेन्मां किं मां सीताब्रवीद् वचः। किमहं तं प्रतिब्रूयामसम्भाष्य सुमध्यमाम्॥
en: How shall I answer Rāma, without consoling Sītā of comely stature, when he will ask me “What message from my Sītā?”

sa: ततो गवाक्षो गवयः सुषेणस्त्वथर्षभो ज्योतिमुखो नलश्च। शैलान्समुत्पाट्य विवृद्धकायाः प्रदुद्रुवुस्तं प्रति राक्षसेन्द्रम्॥
en: Then Gavaksa and Gavaya, Susena, Rsabha, Jyotimukha and Nala, uprooting crags and magnifying their bodies, rushed against the lord of Raksasas.

sa: हा पश्चिमा मे संप्राप्ता दशा वैधव्यदायिनी॥ या मयासीन संबुद्धा कदाचिदपि मन्दया।
en: Alas! by my ill-luck I have attained to that after state making me a widow which I did never think of.

sa: तस्य सीता हृता भार्या रावणेन दुरात्मना। तस्याः सकाशं दूतोऽहं गमिष्ये रामशासनात्॥
en: His wife Sītā has been carried off by the wicked Rāvana. At Rāma's mandate I go to her as an envoy.

sa: चन्द्रश्च नाम द्रोणश्च क्षीरोदे सागरोत्तमे। अमृतं यत्र मथितं तत्र ते परमौषधी॥ तौ तत्र विहितौ देवैः पर्वतौ तौ महोदधौ। अयं वायुसुतो राजन्हनूमांस्तत्र गच्छतु।॥
en: There are (the mountains) named Candra and Drona: where the ambrosia was churned, there is that supreme drug. And those mountains have been placed by the deities in the mighty deep. And, o king, let the son of the Wing-god go thither.

sa: भ्रातरं संपरिष्वज्य कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। प्रणम्य शिरसा तस्मै प्रतस्थे स महाबलः॥
en: Then embracing his brother and going round him and bowing down the head to him, that exceedingly powerful one went out.

sa: ततः सुपर्णः काकुत्स्थौ स्पृष्ट्वा प्रत्यभिनन्द्य च। विममर्श च पाणिभ्यां मुखे चन्द्रसमप्रभे॥
en: Then, touching the Kākutsthas and saluting them, Suparna rubbed with his hands their countenances furnished with the splendour of the Moon.

sa: राघवेण यथा माता सुमित्रा लक्ष्मणेन च। भरतेन च कैकेयी जीवपुत्रास्तथा स्त्रियः॥
en: Females may obtain sons (in the same way) as Kausalyā gave birth to Rāma, Sumitrā to Lakşmaņa and Kaikeyi to Bharata.
